jobs.title: Utvikler – SRE Cloude Engineer
jobs.description:
Oppdragsbeskrivelse:

Digitaliseringsavdelingen (DIGA) er UDI sin IT-avdeling. Avdelingen har en teamorganisering, fordelt på tekniske team, digitaliseringsteam og muliggjørende team. DIGA har ansvaret for UDI og utlendingsforvaltningen sine Digitale løsninger. I tillegg til å ansvaret for drift, forvaltning og utvikling av løsningene har UDI ved DIGA fått i oppdrag å gjennomføre et moderniseringsprogram, modernisering av utlendingsforvaltningen (ModUlf), som skal gjennomføre frem til 2031.

Team Datalagring har behov for en SRE Cloude Engineer. Teamet moderniserer sentrale og kritiske databaser og flytter dem fra on-prem til sky. Teamet trenger å styrke midlertidig med en SRE Engineer som skal bidra med å automatisere, overvåke og videreutvikle UDIs databaseplattform i skyen, og som bidrar til å sette premissene for hvordan vi former fremtidens driftsprosesser.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

Automatisert deployment og drift i sky
Automatisere og standardisere Database plattformdrift ved bruk av Infrastructure as Code (IaC), GitOps og CI/CD
Samarbeide tett med skyutviklingsteamene rundt deploy og runtime-miljø
Etablere og videreutvikle observability (monitoring, logging og alerting) i. Utarbeide en Proof-of-concept for UDI sin Cloud Monitoring med SRE KI agent.
Feilsøke hendelser og gjennomføre strukturerte rotårsak analyser
Administrere storage-, backup- og gjenopprettingsløsninger
Kravstille og lede skymigrasjon
Være kravstiller for nye databaser og lede migreringsprosesser til sky der database er en sentral komponent b. Være en pådriver for å identifisere nye muligheter, holde deg oppdatert på teknologi og trender innen skybaserte databaseplattformer
Vurdere skymigrasjon det dette er hensiktsmessig og forsvarlig
Sikkerhet og støtte til team
Sammen med arkitekter bidra til databasestruktur med fokus på personvern og sikkerhet.
Gjennomføre og bidra til ROS-analyser (risiko- og sårbarhetsvurderinger) for databaseplattform
Støtte team og prosjekter der det er naturlig

Kompetansekrav
:

Ressursen må ha minimum 8 års relevant erfaring innenfor arbeidsoppgavene som er angitt
Ressursen må ha minimum formell kompetanse på bachelorgradsnivå eller tilsvarende innenfor IKT relaterte områder. Lang og relevant dokumentert erfaring (mer enn 12 års erfaring) kan oppveie for kravet om formell utdannelse.
Ressursen må ha dokumentert erfaring med drift og administrasjon av skybaserte databaser, for eksempel Azure SQL, PostgreSQL eller Cosmos DB
Ressursen må har erfaring med å utarbeide POC for Cloude Monitoring med SRE KI-agent eller tilsvarende
Ressursen må ha erfaring med Microsoft Azure (App Services, nettverk, sikkerhet og lagring)
Ressursen må ha erfaring med plattformdrift, observability og livssyklushåndtering
Ressursen må ha kjennskap til Infrastructure as Code og DevOps-prinsipper

Ressursen må ha god skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk

Ressursen må kunne sikkerhetsklareres og autoriseres for nivå BEGRENSET i henhold til sikkerhetsloven

Team Datalagring er på utkikk etter en SRE spesialist som har erfaring med plattformdrift av databasemiljøer i sky, utvikling av overvåkningsløsninger og automatiseringsløsninger ved hjelp av KI i drift og utvikling. Ressursen må ha lang erfaring med skybaserte databaser, gjerne fra miljøer med høye krav til stabilitet, ytelse, sikkerhet og automatisering. Ressursen må ha god forståelse for Infrastructure as Code, automatisering av overvåkning og varsling, trives med å ta i bruk moderne AI-verktøy i driftsarbeidet. Teamet har behov for en senior ressurs med lang og variert bakgrunn innen databaseutvikling. Ressursen må kunne dokumentere erfaring med drift og utvikling av database i sky.

Det er en fordel om ressursen har erfaring med:

Azure og Postgres SQL
API-desgin (OpenAPI/REST)
Infrastructure as Code og automatisering med GitOps, Terraform og CI/CD
Erfaring med å gjennomføre ROS-analyser (Risiko og sårbarhetsvurderinger)
Erfaring med KI/ML-plattformer eller høytytende arbeidsbelastninger er en fordel

Personlige egenskaper:

Initiativrik og løsningsorientert.
Tydelig som kravstiller.
God til å samarbeide med andre.
Omstillingsdyktig og fleksibel
Gode kommunikasjons- og formidlingsegenskaper.
En god prosessdriver.
Kunne være bindeledd mellom teamet og andre applikasjonsteam
Pedagogisk
Ha godt humør.

Omfang og varighet: Fra asap - 30.04.2027, opsjon om forlengelse

Arbeidssted: UDI sine lokaler på Valle, men etter avtale kan noe hjemmekontor benyttes

jobs.title: Fullstack-kehittäjä (pääpaino backend)
jobs.description:
Haluatko tehdä koodia, jolla ratkaistaan oikeita asiakkaiden ongelmia, ja nähdä konkreettisesti oman työsi vaikutuksen?

Etsimme Koho Sales Oy:lle fullstack-kehittäjää osaksi ohjelmistokehitystiimiämme Helsingin Kalasatamaan. Roolin pääpaino on backend-kehityksessä, mutta meillä kehittäjät työskentelevät tarvittaessa myös frontendin parissa.

Koho on suomalainen SaaS-toiminnanohjausjärjestelmä, joka auttaa asiantuntijayrityksiä hallitsemaan muun muassa asiakkuuksia, projekteja, työaikaa, laskutusta, resursointia ja raportointia.

Millaista työ meillä on?

Meillä ohjelmistokehitys on hyvin käytännönläheistä ja lähellä asiakasta. Emme rakenna tuotetta tyhjältä pöydältä tai jahtaa uusimpia teknologiatrendejä, vaan kehitämme yli kymmenen vuotta rakennettua, laajasti käytössä olevaa järjestelmää, jonka pitää toimia luotettavasti asiakkaidemme arjessa. 

Tehtävässä ratkot asiakkaiden käytössä vastaan tulevia ongelmia, toteutat heidän tarpeistaan syntyviä muutoksia ja räätälöintejä sekä kehität samalla Kohoa jatkuvasti paremmaksi. Työssä pääset näkemään konkreettisesti, miten tekemäsi ratkaisut vaikuttavat asiakkaidemme päivittäiseen työhön.

Mitä pääset tekemään?

Fullstack-kehittäjänä työskentelet ennen kaikkea Kohon taustajärjestelmän kehittämisen ja ylläpidon parissa, mutta tehtävään kuuluu myös frontend-kehitystä. Kehitystyömme nojaa vahvasti Ruby on Rails -ohjelmistokehykseen ja MySQL-tietokantoihin. 

Työpöydälläsi voi olla esimerkiksi asiakkaalta noussut ongelma, olemassa olevan toiminnallisuuden parantaminen, integraatio tai uusi ominaisuus.

Työhösi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

Kohon backendin kehittäminen ja ylläpito
asiakkaiden tarpeista ja tiketeistä syntyvien muutosten ja räätälöintien toteuttaminen
bugien ja teknisten ongelmien selvittäminen ja korjaaminen
uusien ominaisuuksien kehittäminen osaksi olemassa olevaa järjestelmää
integraatioiden, rajapintojen ja tietokantojen parissa työskentely
tarvittaessa frontend-muutosten toteuttamista
tuotantoympäristön ongelmatilanteiden selvittäminen
yhteistyö muiden kehittäjien ja koholaisten kanssa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Etsimme ensisijaisesti kehittäjää, jolla on jo jonkin verran kokemusta ohjelmistokehityksestä ja valmiudet tarttua itsenäisesti käytännön kehitystehtäviin. AI-työkalut voivat olla osa työkalupakkiasi, mutta meille on tärkeää, että ymmärrät itse tuottamasi koodin, osaat arvioida ratkaisujen toimivuutta ja laatua sekä pystyt perustelemaan tekemäsi tekniset valinnat. Sinun ei kuitenkaan tarvitse välttämättä olla senioritason konkari. Tärkeintä on riittävä tekninen osaaminen, oppimiskyky ja motivaatio kehittyä.

Toivomme sinulta:
kokemusta backend-ohjelmistokehityksestä
osaamista Ruby on Railsista tai valmiutta ottaa se nopeasti haltuun
perustason osaamista frontend-teknologioista (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
ymmärrystä tietokannoista ja rajapinnoista
hyvää ongelmanratkaisukykyä ja uteliasta otetta ongelmien selvittämiseen
huolellisuutta sekä kiinnostusta laadukkaaseen ja ylläpidettävään koodiin
kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti että yhdessä muiden kanssa
sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.

Kuka viihtyy meillä?

Viihdyt tässä roolissa todennäköisesti hyvin, jos pidät käytännönläheisestä ohjelmistokehityksestä ja ongelmanratkaisusta. Sinua motivoi se, että pääset selvittämään erilaisia tilanteita, kehittämään olemassa olevaa järjestelmää ja tekemään siitä jatkuvasti toimivamman ja paremman.

Työskentelet mielelläsi pitkäikäisen SaaS-tuotteen parissa ja pidät vaihtelevasta tekemisestä: vastaan tulee niin pieniä korjauksia ja asiakastarpeita kuin laajempia kehityskokonaisuuksiakin. Arvostat työn konkreettisuutta ja sitä, että tekemäsi ratkaisut päätyvät oikeasti asiakkaiden käyttöön.

Asiakaslähtöisyys on meille tärkeää myös ohjelmistokehityksessä. Olet kiinnostunut siitä, kuka tekemääsi ratkaisua käyttää, mitä sillä halutaan saavuttaa ja miten se helpottaa asiakkaan arkea. Arvostat sitä, että teknisellä työlläsi on selkeä yhteys asiakkaan tarpeisiin ja käytännön tekemiseen.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Saat ympärillesi kokeneen ohjelmistokehitystiimin ja mahdollisuuden ottaa vastuuta oman osaamisesi mukaan. Työsi vaikutukset näkyvät konkreettisesti asiakkaidemme arjessa, ja joskus ratkaisemasi ongelma helpottaa asiakkaan työtä jo saman päivän aikana.

Meillä on matala organisaatio, rento työilmapiiri ja mahdollisuus vaikuttaa siihen, miten asioita tehdään. Työskentelemme hybridimallilla, ja toimistomme sijaitsee Helsingin Kalasatamassa.

Tarjoamme lisäksi muun muassa lounas- ja matkapuhelinedun, kattavan työterveyshuollon sekä hammasedun.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi palkkatoiveineen viimeistään  25.10.2026
 mennessä. Älä kuitenkaan jää odottelemaan viimeiseen hakupäivään, sillä täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa rekrytoiva esihenkilö Jaakko Kuisma (0503501107) perjantaisin klo 12:00-13:00.

Do you want to take an active role in building the payment processing engine that enables instant transfers across the world, all hosted in the cloud? Join a dedicated small team with focus on high-value features that are central to the strategy of the bank.

Banking Circle is a fully licensed, technology enabled bank processing over €1,5 trillion in payments every year - and growing. We exist to power the global economy’s most ambitious payments businesses with infrastructure that is fast, modern, and engineered for scale. Today, more than 800 people across 11 countries work together as one global team. We move fast, we think boldly, and we build with intent - because our clients depend on us to keep pace with the world’s most dynamic payments flows. We are expanding globally, scaling our capabilities, and deepening our impact, so if you want to shape the future of financial infrastructure - this is the place.

Your team welcomes you with open arms

As our new Development Engineer in the Core Payments Team in Copenhagen, you’ll experience an open and knowledge driven culture, where everyone can thrive, connect with colleagues, learn and grow. Here you will be empowered to make an impact every day.

You will help building a high-end solution where quality, performance, and reliability matters and where we have ambitions for our payment engine to become a central enabler of the company’s future abilities and opportunities.

By joining the team, you will get the chance to build and support a payment engine that enables 24/7 processing and meets demands for continuous high throughput. We are a .NET backend-team that uses a mix of technologies with a focus on the Microsoft Azure-suite, e.g. with Azure Data and Messaging Services (Service Bus, EventHub, etc), and use of Azure DevOps (Pipelines, Repos) hosted in the cloud (Kubernetes).

We are an agile team that has a close collaboration with stakeholders and where there is a high level of trust in, and recognition of, the team’s capabilities.

We offer a hybrid work model for our employees to allow for flexibility and productivity. However, we do expect you to spend most of your time in the office to build community and efficiency in the team.

Exciting work is waiting for you

Development of back-end solutions in C# on Microsoft Azure (Azure SQL Database, Service Bus, Storage Accounts, KeyVault, Kubernetes, etc.).
Applying good engineering practices with an eye for performance and reliability
Carry the technical responsibility of complex feature implementations
Critically assess our way of working and contribute to improving and maturing it
Critically assess the current solutions, and contribute with ideas to continuously improve and scale of our platform
Support our ways of working and be a contributor in improving and maturing them

Things we’ll look for on your resume

To succeed in this role, we expect you to already have experience from a similar role where you have gained experience within .NET. You might already have worked with backend solutions that process high volumes of data with a focus on throughput and availability.

You have experience working with performance sensitive applications and you are comfortable with caching strategies, both in-process and distributed. We run our entire core platform in Azure so you will get a chance to work with modern cloud services and solutions. Therefore, Azure experience is a definite plus, but not a requirement. You are motivated and skilled in designing clean and maintainable solutions.

As a person you are pro-active, responsible, and quality oriented. You have strong analytical skills and a structured way of working and courage to try new things. You are dependable and a knowledge-sharing team-player that thrives with collaboration.

Banking Circle is an international company. Our internal workforce consists of over 50 nationalities, and our clients and partners are located all over the globe. Therefore, our company language is English.

Go ahead and take the first step

We look forward to hearing from you. We review applications and interview candidates continuously. Please note that we don’t accept or consider CVs received through email or direct messages. If you have questions, please reach out to Katja Linnea Serritzlew, Global Recruitment Lead, on kals@bankingcircle.com. No recruitment agencies, please.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, age, religion, sexual orientation, national origin or any other characteristic protected under federal, state or local laws, regulations and ordinances. jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Join AutoProff – Help Shape the Future of Automotive Tech!
🚀

We’re looking for a DevEx Engineer
to join our Empower platform squad “Taycan”
. The squad is split between our HQ in Vejle and our Copenhagen office, so the role can be based in either location.

The Taycan squad helps engineers spend more time delivering product value and less time solving the same technical problems. We build shared capabilities that make the preferred engineering path easier to use.

As our new DevEx Engineer
, you’ll work on the shared tooling, libraries and development patterns used by engineering squads across AutoProff. From scaffolding and shared libraries to patterns such as Outbox, Sagas and messaging, you’ll help make software development simpler and more consistent – so our product squads can spend less time solving the same technical problems and more time building great products.

You’ll work closely with platform engineers, service owners and engineers across our product squads, building solutions that are used across the engineering organisation rather than within just one product area.

Help build shared capabilities and DevEx foundations that enable teams to work effectively with agentic AI.

Use agentic AI in your own DevEx work and share practical learning with engineering teams.

We foster a developer-friendly culture with room to explore new technologies and ways of working. You’ll have access to modern AI-powered tools, join hackathons and take part in internal developer forums where we share ideas and discuss architecture, technology and engineering challenges.

Let's dive into your key responsibilities, you will

Build and evolve shared libraries, scaffolding templates, and CI/CD tooling that remove recurring friction for product squads.
Build paved paths for messaging patterns like Outbox and Sagas, observability, and rehydration/recovery tooling.
Support developers in adopting shared standards for tracing, service integration, and AWS infrastructure.
Work with engineers across product squads to understand recurring friction and turn it into DevEx priorities.
Help squads adopt platform practices that make service ownership, operation, and reuse easier.
Support developers in adopting shared standards for tracing, service integration, AWS infrastructure, and secure, reliable defaults

The need-to-have

Strong engineering experience in .NET / C#.
Proficiency in AWS services (e.g., ECS, Lambda, SQS, S3) and infrastructure-as-code (CDK/Terraform).
Familiarity with microservices, event-driven architecture, and distributed-systems patterns such as Outbox, Sagas, and CDC.
Hands-on experience building shared libraries, observability tooling, and reusable APIs.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills, able to support squads, gather feedback, and drive adoption.

The nice-to-have skills

Experience in platform engineering or developer enablement roles.
Familiarity with internal documentation practices, onboarding tooling, and automated scaffolding.
Hands-on work with service event rehydration, incident recovery tooling, or metadata standards.
Practical experience using LLMs, generative AI, or agentic AI in software development.

We’re eager to hear from you! If this sounds like a great match and sparks your interest, don’t wait, apply today!

About AutoProff

AutoProff was founded in 2013 by the experienced car dealer Jesper Ratza in Denmark. The aim was to digitalize B2B used car trading, helping car dealers increase sales and improve profits.

in August 2022, AutoScout24, the leading specialized pan-European online car marketplace, acquired a majority stake in AutoProff. The partnership has supported the rapid expansion of AutoProff's solutions across Europe and enables the creation of Europe's first fully integrated C2B-B2B-B2C dealing solution for used cars.

At AutoProff, we specialize in providing online B2B used-car dealing solutions designed to improve the buying and selling experience for professional car dealers and their customers.

We are the emerging European leader with more than 150,000 B2B used cars on our online trading platforms annually.

With a focus on effective solutions, digitization and customer service, we are committed to being the home of B2B car dealing for European car dealers.

jobs.description:
We’re looking for an AI Engineer
who enjoys building useful software and wants to do more than experiment with AI, someone who can turn it into reliable solutions that people actually use.

At Boyum IT, we’re exploring how AI can make a real difference across our products and the way we work internally. That might mean building an assistant that helps colleagues find the right information faster, supporting our customer-facing teams with smarter tools, or connecting AI capabilities with our existing products and systems.

This is a practical, hands-on engineering role. You’ll have space to explore new ideas, but the goal is always the same: build something useful, reliable, and ready for the real world.

You don’t need to know every technology in our stack from day one. We’re looking for a strong software engineer who already has some hands-on experience with AI and wants to go deeper.

Location:
Aarhus, Denmark - regular office presence is required.

About the Team:
We call ourselves the “Unified Platform Services” team and work across products and development teams to build shared solutions and make individual product teams more effective. We also help shape how AI is used across our different products. We are a small team with a mix of skills across AI, DevOps, and traditional software development.

What You Will Be Doing

As our new AI engineer colleague, you will be assigned to specific AI projects and deliveries, but you’ll also share what you learn and help other development teams make effective use of AI tools. As part of these two focus areas, you will:

Design, build and maintain AI-powered applications, assistants and services.
Develop backend services and APIs.
Work with LLM-powered applications, RAG, semantic search and agentic workflows.
Build and improve data pipelines and knowledge bases used by AI applications.
Help evaluate AI solutions and improve their quality, reliability and accuracy.
Deploy and operate solutions in Azure.
Work with Docker, CI/CD and Azure DevOps as part of the development lifecycle.
Collaborate with product teams and internal functions to understand problems and turn them into practical technical solutions.
Build reusable tools, integrations and templates that help other teams work effectively with AI.
Share knowledge and contribute to how we use AI across the company.

Our current technology landscape includes Python, PostgreSQL/vector, Dagster, Azure, Azure AI Foundry, MCP, Docker and Azure DevOps.

What We Are Looking For

We think you’ll be a good match if you have:
At least 3+ years of software development experience
, ideally in backend or software engineering
Experience building production services or APIs – ideally AI-related ones
Hands-on experience building AI-powered applications or integrating AI into software
A solid understanding of databases, testing, and maintainable software
Curiosity about where AI genuinely adds value, and where it doesn’t
The ability to work with both technical and non-technical colleagues to understand a problem before jumping to a solution

Nice to Have

Experience with any of the following is a bonus, not a checklist:
C#
Azure or another cloud platform
Docker, DevOps, and CI/CD
Data pipelines
RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or AI agents

Why Join Boyum IT

At Boyum IT, our culture is built around Energy for Life
- the belief that people do their best work when they feel energized, supported, and able to balance work with life outside of work.
For us, Energy for Life means creating a workplace where people can grow professionally, stay healthy, feel connected, and have the flexibility to be present for family, friends, and personal priorities.

What We Offer

A culture built around our Energy for Life
mindset
Flexible work arrangements and respect for work-life balance
A diverse, international team with colleagues from more than 45 nationalities
A supportive workplace focused on wellbeing, inclusion, and belonging
Career development opportunities aligned with your personal goals
Helpful, knowledgeable, and collaborative colleagues
A workplace where your ideas and feedback are valued
Boyum IT committed to responsible business and positive ESG impact

Interested?

Send us your CV in English or Danish
.
We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so there’s no need to wait until the last minute.

You don’t need experience with every technology listed in the advertisement. What matters most is a strong software engineering foundation, practical experience building with AI, and an interest in taking solutions from an idea into reliable everyday use.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

We are seeking a hands-on AI Application Engineer to help bridge the gap between rapid AI prototyping and production-grade software delivery. Implement AI safety patterns, including retrieval grounding, prompt management, input/output filtering, audit logging, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
Develop standardized starter templates, reusable patterns, and engineering playbooks to accelerate AI delivery across multiple teams.
Build automated testing suites (functional, regression, prompt quality, and guardrail validation) and implement system monitoring for latency, token usage, cost, and error tracking.

Maintain solution designs, standard operating procedures, and support guides to ensure long-term maintainability.

Strong expertise in modern languages and frameworks such as React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, .NET, or Java.

Practical experience implementing LLMs, RAG patterns, prompt engineering, vector search, embeddings, and workflow orchestration.
Solid understanding of secure coding practices (secrets management, least-privilege access) and identity frameworks (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT, RBAC).
Experience using CI/CD platforms (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps), containerization, deployment rollbacks, and environment management.
Firm grasp of AI-specific risks, including hallucinations, prompt injection, data leakage, and explainability limitations.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer (.NET) – Medior / Senior
jobs.description:
Bouw mee aan de digitale toekomst van Nederland

Wil jij als Full Stack Developer werken aan slimme digitale oplossingen die dagelijks impact hebben op de inrichting van de openbare ruimte en infrastructuur? Bij CROW krijg je de kans om moderne technologieën zoals .NET, React, Azure, Elasticsearch en AI in te zetten voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Je ontwikkelt niet alleen software, maar helpt ook mee aan de digitale transformatie van een organisatie die richting geeft aan de leefomgeving van Nederland. Of je nu een ervaren medior bent of een senior die graag technische koers bepaalt en collega's inspireert: bij CROW krijg je de ruimte om te bouwen, te vernieuwen en écht het verschil te maken.

Wat ga je doen?

Binnen het team Digitale Informatie is behoefte ontstaan om onze developmentcapaciteit op korte termijn uit te breiden. Daarom zijn wij op zoek naar een Full Stack Developer die zelfstandig werkt aan zowel backend- als frontendontwikkeling en een actieve bijdrage levert aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze digitale informatievoorziening.

Je vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar praktische technische oplossingen en realiseert deze zelfstandig. Daarbij denk je actief mee over architectuur, schaalbaarheid, innovatie en de inzet van moderne technologieën.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

Het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van backend-applicaties in .NET/C#.
Het ontwerpen, bouwen en optimaliseren van API's en data access patterns.
Het ontwikkelen en verbeteren van frontendfunctionaliteiten met React of Angular binnen een MVC-context.
Het meedenken over softwarearchitectuur en technische verbeteringen.
Het werken met zoektechnologieën zoals Elasticsearch.
Het onderzoeken en implementeren van AI-toepassingen, waaronder Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Het inrichten en onderhouden van cloud deployments en CI/CD-processen binnen een Azure- en GitHub-omgeving.
Het samenwerken met collega's, product owners en andere stakeholders om onze digitale dienstverlening continu te verbeteren.

Wat bieden we jou?

Een salaris tussen € 4.522,- en € 6.908,- bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur.
Een dienstverband van 32 tot 40 uur per week, bij voorkeur fulltime.
25 vakantiedagen en 12 adv-dagen.
Een persoonlijk keuzebudget bestaande uit 6 (van de 12) ADV dagen, eindejaarsuitkering en vakantiegeld.
Een premievrije pensioenopbouw.
Hybride werken, met een thuiswerk-, internet- en eenmalige werkplekvergoeding.
Een laptop en moderne tooling om optimaal te kunnen werken.
Een maandelijks vitaliteitsbudget en korting op je sportschoolabonnement via onze bedrijfsregeling.
Volop ruimte voor opleiding en ontwikkeling op het gebied van cloud, AI en moderne softwareontwikkeling.
Een uitgebreid introductie- en inwerkprogramma.
Een uitdagende functie binnen een ambitieuze organisatie met maatschappelijke impact.

Jij voelt je hier thuis als...

je energie krijgt van eigenaarschap en verantwoordelijkheid;
je zelfstandig kunt werken, maar ook graag samenwerkt met collega's;
je enthousiast wordt van een omgeving waarin technologie continu in ontwikkeling is;
je graag werkt aan innovatieve oplossingen en nieuwe technologieën;
je het leuk vindt om zowel backend als frontend op te pakken.

Jouw talent

Je kijkt verder dan individuele features en denkt vanuit het grotere geheel. Je begrijpt hoe systemen samenhangen, hebt oog voor technische verbeteringen en combineert analytisch vermogen met een pragmatische, hands-on instelling. Je schrijft onderhoudbare, testbare en goed gedocumenteerde code.

Wij zoeken een van de volgende profielen:

Medior Full Stack Developer

Circa 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring.
Een sterke basis in .NET/C# en MVC.
Ervaring met backendontwikkeling, API's en data access patterns.
Basiskennis van frontendontwikkeling met React of Angular.
Basiskennis van cloudtechnologie en CI/CD.
Interesse om je verder te ontwikkelen op het gebied van AI, RAG en Elasticsearch.

Senior Full Stack Developer

Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring.
Een sterke basis in .NET/C# en MVC.
Ervaring met backendontwikkeling, API's en data access patterns.
Ervaring met React of Angular binnen een MVC-context.
Brede ervaring met Azure, GitHub, CI/CD en cloud deployment.
Ervaring met Elasticsearch en AI-oplossingen zoals Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
In staat om architectuurkeuzes te maken, richting te geven aan technische ontwikkelingen en collega's te coachen.

Verder

Heb je een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk..
Ben je woonachtig in Nederland zodat je ook op kantoor met collega’s kunt verbinden.

Over CROW

Zonder CROW zou Nederland er heel anders uit zien. Zodra je de deur uitgaat en om je heen kijkt, zie je een openbare ruimte en infrastructuur die is vormgegeven met behulp van onze richtlijnen, systematieken en praktische tools. CROW ontwikkelt deze breed gedragen collectieve richtlijnen en kennis samen met belangrijke partijen als opdrachtgevers, opdrachtnemers, adviseurs en toeleveranciers. Wij vervullen hierbij een belangrijke verbindende rol.

CROW faciliteert kennisdeling, bevordert kennistoepassing en duidt beschikbare informatie. CROW richt zich hierbij op de praktijk van vandaag en morgen. CROW bevindt zich in de overgangsfase van een traditioneel kennisbedrijf naar een kennisbedrijf wat zich ook op de digitalisering van deze kennis richt. Een belangrijk doel is om de gebruikers van de kennis van CROW (onze klanten) zo optimaal mogelijk te bedienen door de juiste content in de juiste vorm en juiste samenhang digitaal aan te bieden in het werkproces van de klant.

Wil je meer weten?

Voor meer informatie over deze vacature kun je contact opnemen met Rick Otterloo, Productowner via rick.otterloo@crow.nl.

jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.location: Landau in der Pfalz, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
jobs.description:
Role Overview

So arbeiten wir – bitte aufmerksam lesen

Diese Stelle passt nicht zu jedem, und das ist Absicht. Damit du einschätzen kannst, ob sie zu dir passt:

Du baust die Schienen, nicht nur die Züge. Während die anderen KI-Rollen an konkreten Use-Cases arbeiten, verantwortest du das Querschnittliche: Infrastruktur, Frameworks, wiederverwendbare Bausteine, Guardrails. Deine Arbeit zahlt sich darin aus, dass andere schneller und sicherer liefern können.
Effizienz ist dein ständiger Maßstab. KI-Consumption – Token, Compute, API-Kosten – wächst schnell und unbemerkt. Du behältst sie im Blick, triffst fundierte Make-or-Buy-Entscheidungen (lokal vs. Cloud, selbst bauen vs. einkaufen) und kannst sie begründen.
Du wirst öfter "nein" sagen als "ja". Nicht jede schöne Idee braucht eigene Infrastruktur, und nicht jedes Modell muss selbst gehostet werden. Du erkennst, wann der pragmatische Weg der bessere ist – und vertrittst das auch gegenüber begeisterten Kolleginnen und Kollegen.
Jedes Teammitglied handelt sehr autonom. Du setzt dir deinen eigenen Maßstab und prüfst deine eigenen Ergebnisse kritisch, bevor jemand anderes es tut. Austausch und Feedback gibt es selbstverständlich – aber die Qualitätssicherung deiner Arbeit beginnt bei dir.
Du bist der Spezialist für dein Gebiet. Unser Team ist bewusst interdisziplinär aufgestellt, mit kaum Überlappungen zwischen den Disziplinen. Du hast Spezialisten für Frontend, Backend, UX und KI-Anwendungen an deiner Seite – aber Plattform, Betrieb und Effizienz sind dein Feld, und du verantwortest es fachlich selbst.
Wir entwickeln AI-gestützt – konsequent. Tools wie Claude Code oder Cursor sind bei uns Alltag, nicht Experiment. Das verschiebt den Schwerpunkt der Arbeit: weniger Code selbst tippen, mehr Architektur vorgeben und Ergebnisse kritisch prüfen. Du musst nicht jede Zeile selbst geschrieben haben – aber du stehst für jede Zeile gerade, die du ablieferst.
Wöchentliche Freiräume sind fest eingeplant – rund 10 % deiner Arbeitszeit. Zeit für fachliche Weiterentwicklung, eigene Ideen und kreativen Austausch ist bei uns Teil der Arbeitswoche – kein Nice-to-have, das im Tagesgeschäft verdampft.
Ergebnisgetrieben und prozessual schlank. Wir brauchen schnelle, pragmatische Lösungen, die im Alltag funktionieren – keine über Monate ausgefeilten 100%-Systeme. Die Plattform wächst mit den realen Bedürfnissen, nicht mit theoretischen.

Wenn du am produktivsten bist, wenn dir jemand eine fertige Architektur und ein abgestecktes Backlog vorlegt, wirst du bei uns nicht glücklich. Wenn dich reizt, ein Fundament aus dem Nichts zu bauen, auf dem andere aufbauen – dann lies weiter.

Unser Stack

Wir implementieren produktnah überwiegend in C# / .NET. Python nutzen wir, wo es sinnvoll ist – für Prototypen, KI-spezifische Werkzeuge, Datenarbeit und Tooling. Der Schwerpunkt liegt aber klar auf C#. Unsere Frontends bauen wir in React – für diese Rolle kein Muss, aber nützlich. Für KI-Betrieb und -Infrastruktur erwarten wir Vertrautheit mit gängigen Inferenz- und Orchestrierungs-Frameworks sowie mit Containerisierung.

Your Tasks

Die technische Plattform für unsere KI-Anwendungen konzipieren, aufbauen und betreiben: Modell-Hosting, Inferenz, API-Gateways/Routing, wiederverwendbare Bausteine
Lokale / self-hosted LLMs evaluieren, einrichten und betreiben – inklusive Quantisierung, GPU-Dimensionierung und Performance
KI-Consumption und -Kosten transparent machen und aktiv steuern; fundierte Make-or-Buy- und Lokal-vs.-Cloud-Entscheidungen treffen und begründen
Frameworks, Tools und Standards für das Team auswählen und etablieren – Guardrails, die KI-Entwicklung schneller und sicherer machen
Erfolgreiche Prototypen der anderen KI-Rollen in einen tragfähigen, betreibbaren Zustand bringen – bis hin zur Übergabe an R&D oder in den produktiven Betrieb
CI/CD, Monitoring und Betriebsthemen für KI-Lösungen verantworten
Ergebnisse und Empfehlungen gegenüber Fach- und Business-Teams präsentieren – auf dem jeweiligen technischen Niveau deines Gegenübers

Your Profile

Tiefes Veständnis und praktische Erfahrung im Betrieb von KI-/LLM-Anwendungen in einem Unternehmen: Inferenz-Frameworks (z. B. vLLM, Ollama, llama.cpp, TGI), API-Gateways/Routing (z. B. LiteLLM), RAG- und Embedding-Infrastruktur
Operative, im Unternehmenskontext angewandte Erfahrung mit lokalen Modellen / Self-Hosting von LLMs – inklusive Quantisierung und Ressourcendimensionierung
Mehrjährige, fundierte praktische Erfahrung innerhalb eines Unternehmens in der Entwicklung von Softwarelösungen, davon ein solider Teil in C# / .NET – mit erkennbarer technischer Tiefe
Erfahrung mit Containerisierung (Docker), CI/CD und Betriebsthemen
Ein waches Auge für Kosten und Effizienz – du kannst KI-Consumption messen, einordnen und optimieren
Gute Übersicht über aktuelle Trends, verfügbare Off-the-shelf-Lösungen und neue Entwicklungen im KI-Umfeld – du weißt, wann man baut und wann man kauft
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (Teamsprache ist Deutsch) und gute Englischkenntnisse
Überwiegende Arbeit im Homeoffice, Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Reisen in unser HQ in Landau (ca. 5–10 % der Arbeitszeit)

Must have

Praktische Erfahrung innerhalb eines Unternehmens mit lokalen Modellen / Self-Hosting von LLMs – inklusive Quantisierung und Ressourcendimensionierung
Praktische Erfahrung innerhalb eines Unternehmens im Betrieb von KI-/LLM-Anwendungen: Inferenz-Frameworks (z. B. vLLM, Ollama, llama.cpp, TGI), API-Gateways/Routing (z. B. LiteLLM), RAG- und Embedding-Infrastruktur
Erfahrung mit Containerisierung (Docker), CI/CD und Betriebsthemen
Du kannst "nein" sagen, ohne Türen zu schließen und ein Scheitern eingestehen, auch wenn du schon Aufwand investiert hast

Nice to have

Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung oder Anleitung von Entwicklern
Gute Python-Kenntnisse für Tooling und Prototyping
Erfahrung mit Datenaufbereitung und -pipelines (ETL/ELT)
React / moderne Web-Frontends
Erfahrung mit GPU-Infrastruktur und Kostenoptimierung im Cloud-Umfeld

That sounds like you?

Du denkst in Systemen und Fundamenten, nicht nur in einzelnen Lösungen – und baust so, dass andere darauf aufbauen können.
Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Verhältnismäßigkeit – du baust die Infrastruktur, die das Problem braucht, nicht die größtmögliche. Und du erkennst, wann der pragmatische Weg der richtige ist.
Du kannst "nein" sagen, ohne Türen zu schließen – und ein Scheitern eingestehen, auch wenn du schon Aufwand investiert hast.
Du prüfst deine eigenen Ergebnisse kritisch, bevor jemand anderes es tut.
Ein offenes Auge für Defizite und Potenziale, technisch wie organisatorisch

Reasons to become part of AMDT

Transformative Möglichkeiten und integrative Kultur: Werde Teil eines dynamischen, sich weiterentwickelnden Unternehmens, in dem Wachstum gefördert wird, deine Beiträge geschätzt werden und du in einer vielfältigen, unterstützenden Gemeinschaft zusammenarbeiten und dich entfalten kannst.
Flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten: Arbeite so, wie es für dich am besten ist – remote, hybrid oder in unserem hochmodernen Büro.
Zukunftssicherheit: Wir investieren in deine Zukunft und leisten einen Beitrag von 20 % zu einem umfassenden betrieblichen Alterversversongung.
Zusätzliche Krankenversicherung: Genieße zusätzliche Sicherheit mit einer Krankenzusatzversicherung, die dein Wohlbefinden über das Grundlegende hinaus unterstützt.
Unternehmensvorteile: Profitiere von exklusiven Rabatten auf ausgewählte Marken, um deinen Alltag zu bereichern.
Kontinuierliches Lernen: Nutze Preply für einfaches Sprachenlernen und unterstütze so deine persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung.
Meilensteine feiern: Freue dich über Geschenke zu wichtigen Lebensereignissen wie Heirat, Geburt eines Kindes oder deinem Jubiläum bei uns.

Contact us

Wenn Du Fragen zu der Stelle haben solltest, wende Dich bitte an unser Recruiting-Team (Chiara & Dirk) unter hiring@amdt.com mit Verweis auf den Titel der Stelle

About Us

AMDT is the global market and technology leader for versioning and backup solutions in industrial automation. With its octoplant software platform, the company secures the automation of production processes through strong end-point management, where it consistently records and monitors changes to configurations, programming and project statuses in production. This minimizes downtime, increases efficiency, quality and safety standards, and saves costs as well as resources. As a modular solution, octoplant can be linked to different automation technologies and devices, regardless of the manufacturer.

AMDT was formed in 2022 from the merger of the two established market leaders AUVESY GmbH and MDT Software Inc. The company is headquartered in Landau, Pfalz, Germany, with additional locations in the USA and China. The company works with more than 100 partners on all continents and serves over 3,000 customers worldwide

jobs.description:
Please submit your application in English

What Makes Us a Great Place To Work

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work
list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

Who You’ll Work With

You’ll join our Engineering experts within the AI, Insights & Solutions
team
. This team is part of Bain’s digital capabilities practice, which includes experts in analytics, engineering, product management, and design. In this multidisciplinary environment, you'll leverage deep technical expertise with business acumen to help clients tackle their most transformative challenges. You’ll work on integrated teams alongside our general consultants and clients to develop data-driven strategies and innovative solutions. Together, we create human-centric solutions that harness the power of data and artificial intelligence to drive competitive advantage for our clients. Our collaborative and supportive work environment fosters creativity and continuous learning, enabling us to consistently deliver exceptional results.

What You’ll Do

As an Expert Manager, Software Engineering, you will lead the development and building of software applications that address complex business and technology problems in various industries. You will guide a diverse engineering team through the entire engineering life cycle. Your responsibilities will include designing, developing, optimizing, and deploying cutting-edge software engineering solutions and infrastructure at the production scale required by the world’s largest companies, with a strong focus on ensuring technical delivery supports business strategy, operating model evolution, and sustainable value creation.

Shape & scope client solutions. Work with Bain consulting teams and product owners to translate business problems into prioritized backlogs and technical roadmaps for cross-functional engineering squads
Translate technical capabilities into client-ready product and transformation outcomes by shaping product direction, operating model implications, and change management approaches that support adoption and measurable business impact
Own full-stack design & build. Lead the architecture, development and documentation of AI applications, including coding and integrating third-party services or frameworks that accelerate delivery and long-term maintainability
Establish AI-native software engineering best practices. Define and enforce standards around component libraries/design systems, automated testing, linting, CI/CD, accessibility and performance optimization
Develop reusable libraries & accelerators. Create and curate shared code assets that reduce time-to-value across multiple client projects and internal initiatives.
Lead the full delivery lifecycle. Set quality gates, supervise code reviews, ensure robust unit/integration test coverage, manage release planning, and oversee post-deployment monitoring and incident resolution
Partner on UI/UX excellence. Collaborate with designers to ship inclusive, responsive interfaces
Mentor & grow engineers. Provide day-to-day technical coaching for senior and mid-level engineers through pair programming, architecture sessions and constructive feedback
Upskill client engineering teams. Coach client developers on modern tooling and DevOps/cloud-native practices, ensuring sustainable ownership after Bain’s engagement
Advance AI-native technology adoption. Champion containerization, infrastructure-as-code, automated observability and secure-by-design principles to improve scalability, reliability and security
Contribute to communities of practice. Share lessons learned and emerging technology trends through internal forums, brown-bag sessions and knowledge assets
Support talent acquisition & onboarding. Participate in interviewing, technical assessments and mentoring of new hires to build a high-caliber engineering cohort
Travel is required. This position requires regional travel away from your home office/primary working location. Travel frequency and destinations will vary based on project needs

About You

Technical Skills & Knowledge

Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
6+ years of end-to-end experience designing, building and maintaining production-grade full-stack applications
Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into solution, platform products or roadmaps
4+ years building server-side services using FastAPI, Node.js/Express, Flask, Django, .NET Core or Java Spring Boot or similar technologies, including the design of APIs
3+ years of architecting and operating micro-service ecosystems, emphasizing service discovery, observability, CI/CD automation and blue-/green or canary deployments
Expert knowledge of Python, JavaScript and/or other programming languages
Experience with cloud-native delivery on AWS, Azure or GCP, knowledge of managed services, serverless patterns and infrastructure-as-code such as Terraform, CloudFormation or Bicep
Proficient with containerization and orchestration, Docker, Kubernetes and related tooling (Helm, Argo CD)
Experience with database architecture across relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL/document stores (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis), with solid SQL skills
Solid computer science fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, object-oriented and functional paradigms, automated testing, performance profiling
Excellence in software architecture design, including modular, distributed, and cloud-native systems, scalability, resiliency, maintainability, and observability
Experience with data security, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT, SSO/cloud IAM, encryption in transit, at rest, and awareness of data protection regulations.
Ideally, experience with modern AI/ML development, working with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, agentic SDKs and AI safety
Ideally, hands-on experience with modern web technologies such as React, Angular, Vue.js, TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS3
Proven leader and mentor with ability to lead engineering squads, set coding standards, perform rigorous code reviews and up skill junior engineers.
Agile delivery mindset, practical experience with Scrum or Kanban, story-point estimation, backlog grooming and the use of Git-based workflows, Jira and automated CI/CD pipelines.
Professional fluency in English and German

Interpersonal Skills

Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to explain and discuss technicalities of solutions, algorithms and techniques with colleagues and clients from other disciplines
Curiosity, proactivity and critical thinking
Ability to collaborate with people at all levels and with multi-office/region teams
Ability to work independently and juggle priorities to thrive in a fast paced and ambiguous environment, while also collaborating as part of a team in complex situations

If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What Sets Us Apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication
. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 100 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the Language Products Track
. This is the heart of DeepL. You will be building and expanding our flagship translation products, the core engines that power everything from our consumer web translator to our Enterprise Customization Hub (Glossaries, Translation Memory, and Style Rules) and complex multimedia localization flows.

We are shifting gears from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers just to implement UI tickets or optimize algorithms in isolation. We hire product-obsessed
people who care deeply about the user experience and the business impact of their code . You will build the interfaces and backend systems that allow a global enterprise to maintain their brand voice across 100+ languages effortlessly, while keeping the experience simple enough for a casual user.

Your Responsibilities

Own the Core Experience End-to-End: You will architect and build complex, user-facing features across our primary translation products . Whether you are building the UI for the translation flow, engineering the backend logic to parse and translate complex document formats (PDF, Word, PowerPoint) without losing formatting, or integrating DeepL directly into enterprise workflows, you own the outcome.
Build for "Consumer-Grade" Enterprise: You will solve a unique product challenge: building an interface that feels instant and magical for a B2C user, but is powerful enough to handle the complex, multi-party collaboration and localization workflows required by enterprise teams.
Architect for Ambiguity: You will make high-stakes technical decisions regarding state management, API integrations, and performance. You don't wait for perfect requirements; you prototype, measure user friction, and iterate fast .
Bridge the Gap: You are bilingual in "Engineering" and "Business." You will collaborate closely with Research, Product, and Design teams to translate complex AI constraints into an intuitive UX . You will help win market trust by building transparency and performance metrics directly into the product.

Qualities we look for

A "Product-First" Mindset: You care deeply about who uses your software. You ask "Why are we building this?" before writing a line of code. You measure success by user adoption and reduced friction, not just pull requests merged.
Front-end Heavy Full-Stack Fluency: You are a strong Front End engineer who is comfortable traversing the stack to deliver a feature. You can build a highly interactive, performant UI in React and design the supporting backend logic in Python and C#/.NET Core, with the support of agentic tooling.
High Agency & Bias for Action: You don't wait for permission. If you see a performance bottleneck in the translation flow, you profile it. If the documentation for a new API is missing, you write it . You are comfortable unblocking yourself and your team.
A "System Thinker" for UI/UX: You understand that a simple UI often hides massive backend complexity. You can design systems that handle large document states, manage complex terminology rules (Glossaries), and maintain high performance in the browser.

What We Offer

Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

jobs.title: Senior Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
What’s the role?

Gen II is building out its Data & Integration Platform — the central integration backbone connecting 40+ systems across our fund administration technology estate. At the heart of DIP is an AI-assisted integration factory: a structured, repeatable delivery engine for building, testing, and deploying integration adapters at pace.

We are looking for a Senior Integration Engineer to join the DIP team and take direct ownership of integration delivery — combining deep Azure integration expertise with an embedded AI-assisted development practice. This is not a role for someone who is learning how to use AI tooling; we want someone who already works this way and can help us push the factory model further.

You will be expected to come in, get up to speed quickly, and drive forward integration workstreams with minimal oversight. We need a self-starter who can take a requirement, own it end-to-end, and deliver at pace and quality. You will report to and work closely with the Associate Director of Data Engineering.

What You’ll Be Doing

Integration Factory & AI-Assisted Delivery

Building and extending reusable system wrappers (Python) for applications and systems across the Gen II technology estate
Using AI tooling (LLMs, codegen, Claude) across all integration development — scaffolding Function Apps, generating Logic Apps workflows, producing APIM policies, building test cases, generating IaC, and automating documentation; AI assistance is the default mode of working, not a selective shortcut
Contributing to the factory’s pattern library — standardising error handling, retry logic, logging, and payload structures across all integration components
Driving CI/CD pipeline integration for adapter delivery — automated test execution, linting, and deployment gates

Azure Integration Engineering

Designing and building integration adapters using Azure Function Apps (Python) — the primary execution pattern across DIP
Developing Logic Apps Standard workflows, including WDL authoring, scope actions, error handling, and retry patterns — with AI-assisted workflow generation embedded in the build process
Configuring Azure API Management — inbound/outbound policies, managed identity auth, versioning, and throttling — leveraging AI to draft, validate, and document policies
Working with Azure Service Bus for event-driven and async messaging patterns
Contributing to IaC outputs (Bicep) for per-adapter infrastructure — using AI to scaffold and maintain templates

Delivery & Collaboration

Taking integration workstreams from requirement to production with minimal hand-holding
Writing clean, well-tested Python with pytest-based test suites aligned to DIP QA standards
Working closely with the Associate Director of Data Engineering, DIP Architect, BAs, and QA — raising blockers early and documenting decisions clearly
Collaborating with data engineers to ensure ingress and egress integration outputs land cleanly in / out of Snowflake

The ideal background for this role:

5+ years of hands-on integration engineering experience — evidenced in role history, not just a skills list
Deep practical experience with Azure Function Apps, Logic Apps Standard, Service Bus, and API Management — you have written the workflows and configured the policies yourself
Strong Python development — clean, production-quality code with proper error handling, logging, and test coverage
Demonstrable experience building or contributing to an integration factory — reusable adapter patterns, scaffolding, CI/CD automation
Active use of AI-assisted development in integration delivery — pattern generation, code scaffolding, IaC templating, documentation automation; this should be embedded in how you work, not aspirational
Ability to own workstreams independently and drive delivery without close management

jobs.title: 2027 Technology Developer Graduate Programme Northampton
jobs.description:
If you're a recent graduate or soon-to-be graduate, join us and unlock a world of carefully curated experiences, knowledge, and connections to shape your career. Along the way, you can expect all the training and support you need to make your mark on the world. Put simply, we’ll empower you to help determine how we do things and where we go next. Our graduates are a vital part of our success, and we welcome applications from people from all walks of life. Whoever you are and wherever you want to join us, if you’re curious, creative, and ambitious, this is a world in which you can truly belong.

Our Expert Programme

You'll join our expert programme, a 1 year targeted, fast-track programme designed to give you depth and breadth of experience. Participating in job-based bespoke training from the start enabling you to go fully-equipped into your role as you develop specialist technical expertise.

Why the Technology Developer programme?

As a Developer, you’ll help design, build, test and maintain systems used across Barclays. This is more than writing code; you’ll play a role in solving complex problems for clients and customers. You may work with technologies including Java, C++, C#, Python, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, containers, DevOps, cloud, machine learning, scripting and real-time systems.

To be considered for this opportunity, you'll be motivated with a strong degree or expected degree achieved before June 2027.

You’ll also bring a genuine interest in technology, strong problem-solving skills and the drive to deliver innovative solutions.

Barclays will accept applications from candidates who require visa sponsorship to work in the UK and will provide a skilled worker visa for successful applicants if they meet the Home Office’s eligibility criteria for a skilled worker visa.

Successful applicants who are not eligible to receive a skilled worker visa, and who we are therefore unable to secure a skilled worker visa for, will be required to have their own legal right to work in the UK on a full-time basis from August 2027 to August 2028.

Working In Northampton

Our environmentally friendly campus is designed with people in mind. With cafés, changing areas, collaboration spaces, green spaces and wellbeing areas, it’s a place where work feels good. With ample parking, strong public transport links, a shuttle bus service, and local amenities nearby, getting here is easy too.

It is the policy of Barclays to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by law.

The closing date for applications is 25 September 2026. Please note that this vacancy may close ahead of the advertised date due to application volumes, and we therefore recommend submitting your application as early as possible.

Purpose of the role

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.

Accountabilities

Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
Collaboration with peers, participation in code reviews, and promotion of a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.

Partner with other functions and business areas.

Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.

jobs.title: Volunteer Web Designer and Developer to Help Ashoka Fellows Strengthen and Grow their Work with Ashoka
jobs.description:
This is an opportunity to work with an Ashoka Staff

This is an unpaid, volunteer opportunity

About The Affiliated Organization

Founded in 1980, Ashoka pioneered the field of social entrepreneurship. We are now the largest association of leading social entrepreneurs in the world, a network of 4000+ Ashoka Fellows in 99 countries at work creating systemic change on the most pressing social and environmental issues of our time. We find, support and collaborate with our Fellows to help scale their solutions across nations and continents and work with a wide range of partners to create an "Everyone a Changemaker" world, one in which we all can find and develop our power to create meaningful change for the good of all.

For more information, please visit www.ashoka.org

Job Description

Ashoka is looking for senior-level professionals in Web Design and Development who can provide our Fellows with professional consults and project based support. We are creating an elite team of 10-15 members from different world regions (to reflect cultural contexts and language) in this field and in nine others of similarly high-value skillsets. We are calling these members Ashoka Professional Support Partners (PSPs) rather than "volunteers" to reflect the expertise and commitment to impact they will bring to our global community.

As an Ashoka Support Partner your expertise will be promoted to Fellows over the course of two to three months. If there is a need that meets your interests and availability, an introduction will be made so that you can learn more details about the support partnership and ways that you can contribute. Until that time your name and contact details will be held confidentially to protect your privacy.

As a Member Of The Web Design And Development Team You Will Be Working At The Intersection Of Digital Craft, Social-enterprise Literacy, And Capacity-building. Our Ashoka Fellows Are Leading Social Entrepreneurs Running Organizations That Often Need Stronger Digital Foundations To Scale Their Impact. A Senior Web Professional On This Team Would Help To

Build or rebuild Fellow and Fellow-led organizations' websites — from strategy and information architecture through design, development, and launch — so Fellows can credibly tell their story, recruit supporters, and raise funds online.
Design brand-aligned digital experiences — visual identity, UI/UX, landing pages, donation/fundraising flows, and campaign microsites that reflect each Fellow's mission and audience.
Modernize and maintain existing sites — auditing, migrating, and upgrading legacy platforms applying rigor to Fellows' sites.
Integrate essential nonprofit tooling — connecting sites to CRM/donor systems, email platforms, payment/donation processors, analytics, and multilingual/localization support for Fellows working across regions.
Coach and build Fellow capacity — transferring skills to Fellows and their teams so they can update content, run campaigns, and sustain their digital presence independently rather than depending on outside help indefinitely.

Please let us know today if you'd like to join this small but mighty team!

Volunteer Logistics

Estimated hours required per week: 5-10

The estimated duration of the project is: 1-3 months

This position is Virtual (Remote)

Language Requirements

English

Desired Skills And Experience

8+ years of progressively responsible web design and development experience, including at least 2-3 years in a senior or lead role (leading builds, mentoring, or owning architecture decisions).
A demonstrated portfolio of live websites spanning design through deployment, ideally including nonprofit, multilingual, or multi-site/multi-region projects.
Proven experience working remotely in distributed, cross-cultural teams.
Strong command of user-centered design, information architecture, and visual/brand design principles.
Proficiency in design tools (Figma, Adobe Creative Suite) and prototyping.
Understanding of accessibility, responsive/mobile-first design, and performance. Development skills Front-end: HTML5, CSS3, modern JavaScript, and a framework such as React.
Back-end and CMS fluency — especially Drupal and/or WordPress, with experience in theming, custom modules, and migrations.
Experience integrating third-party systems (Salesforce/CRM, donation platforms, email tools) and working with APIs.
Familiarity with cloud hosting and DevOps basics and basic SEO/analytics setup.
Literacy in social entrepreneurship and systems-change work, so digital solutions serve mission and scale rather than just looking polished.
Experience with budget-conscious, resource-light environments typical of early-stage Fellow organizations.
Intercultural fluency to work across countries and multilingual contexts, with strong English (additional languages a plus).
A coaching, capacity-strengthening mindset — willingness to teach and document, not just deliver.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
AI Engineer / Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

Build technology that solves real business problems
We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer / Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
to work at the intersection of technology, data, AI and the business.

This is not a traditional software engineering role. You will work directly with our investment, operations and distribution teams, spending time with the people who use our technology to understand their workflows, identify meaningful problems and build solutions that make a measurable difference.

You will have the autonomy to take ideas from problem definition through to production, often moving from prototype to a working solution in days or weeks rather than months.

The role
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will:
Work directly with business teams to understand their workflows, challenges and opportunities.
Identify high-impact problems where software, automation, data or AI can improve how we operate.
Rapidly prototype solutions, test them with users and iterate based on real-world feedback.
Take successful prototypes through to production, building secure, reliable and maintainable services.
Work across the full technology stack, including backend services, APIs, data pipelines and user-facing applications.
Integrate data and systems across APIs, databases, files and message queues, turning complex and fragmented data into useful products and services.
Apply modern AI and LLM capabilities to accelerate delivery and create new ways of working.
Partner closely with engineering, data and platform teams to align with architecture, security and technology standards.
Maintain a strong focus on security, governance, data protection and operational resilience, particularly where solutions interact with client assets and regulated activity.

About you
You are a hands-on engineer and pragmatic problem solver who enjoys being close to the people you build for.
You are comfortable operating in environments where the problem is not always clearly defined. You can ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, make sensible trade-offs and move quickly from an idea to something users can actually work with.
You are equally comfortable discussing architecture with engineers, mapping a business process with a subject matter expert, or explaining a technical trade-off to a senior stakeholder.
Most importantly, you care about building the right thing, not simply building things right.

Experience needed for the role:
4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering and supporting production systems.
Experience taking projects end to end, from problem definition and design through development, deployment and ongoing improvement.
Experience working directly with users, clients or business stakeholders is highly desirable.
Strong experience integrating APIs, databases, files and messaging systems, and working with complex or imperfect real-world data.
Experience in financial services, investment management, asset management or another regulated, data-intensive environment is highly desirable.
Experience using modern AI/LLM technologies, or a demonstrated ability and enthusiasm to adopt them quickly.

Technical skills
We are looking for strong engineering fundamentals rather than a specific technology background. Experience with one or more of the following is valuable:
Programming: Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, C# or Go.
Full stack development: backend services, APIs and modern web applications.
Data: SQL, PostgreSQL, Azure SQL, data modelling, cloud storage and graph technologies, including GraphRAG.
Cloud and infrastructure: Azure, containers, CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
Security: authentication, authorisation, data isolation, input validation and secure handling of sensitive information.
AI: LLMs, AI-assisted development, intelligent automation and emerging AI application patterns.

If you are an engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, working directly with users and turning ideas into production technology, we would like to hear from you.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

At least 5 years of advanced level Active Directory experience.

jobs.title: Forward Deployment Engineer
jobs.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

Build technology that solves real business problems
We are looking for an experienced Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
to work at the intersection of technology, data, AI and the business.

This is not a traditional software engineering role. You will work directly with our investment, operations and distribution teams, spending time with the people who use our technology to understand their workflows, identify meaningful problems and build solutions that make a measurable difference.

You will have the autonomy to take ideas from problem definition through to production, often moving from prototype to a working solution in days or weeks rather than months.

The role
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will:
Work directly with business teams to understand their workflows, challenges and opportunities.
Identify high-impact problems where software, automation, data or AI can improve how we operate.
Rapidly prototype solutions, test them with users and iterate based on real-world feedback.
Take successful prototypes through to production, building secure, reliable and maintainable services.
Work across the full technology stack, including backend services, APIs, data pipelines and user-facing applications.
Integrate data and systems across APIs, databases, files and message queues, turning complex and fragmented data into useful products and services.
Apply modern AI and LLM capabilities to accelerate delivery and create new ways of working.
Partner closely with engineering, data and platform teams to align with architecture, security and technology standards.
Maintain a strong focus on security, governance, data protection and operational resilience, particularly where solutions interact with client assets and regulated activity.

About you
You are a hands-on engineer and pragmatic problem solver who enjoys being close to the people you build for.
You are comfortable operating in environments where the problem is not always clearly defined. You can ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, make sensible trade-offs and move quickly from an idea to something users can actually work with.
You are equally comfortable discussing architecture with engineers, mapping a business process with a subject matter expert, or explaining a technical trade-off to a senior stakeholder.
Most importantly, you care about building the right thing, not simply building things right.

Experience needed for the role:
4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering and supporting production systems.
Experience taking projects end to end, from problem definition and design through development, deployment and ongoing improvement.
Experience working directly with users, clients or business stakeholders is highly desirable.
Strong experience integrating APIs, databases, files and messaging systems, and working with complex or imperfect real-world data.
Experience in financial services, investment management, asset management or another regulated, data-intensive environment is highly desirable.
Experience using modern AI/LLM technologies, or a demonstrated ability and enthusiasm to adopt them quickly.

Technical skills
We are looking for strong engineering fundamentals rather than a specific technology background. Experience with one or more of the following is valuable:
Programming: Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, C# or Go.
Full stack development: backend services, APIs and modern web applications.
Data: SQL, PostgreSQL, Azure SQL, data modelling, cloud storage and graph technologies, including GraphRAG.
Cloud and infrastructure: Azure, containers, CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
Security: authentication, authorisation, data isolation, input validation and secure handling of sensitive information.
AI: LLMs, AI-assisted development, intelligent automation and emerging AI application patterns.

If you are an engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, working directly with users and turning ideas into production technology, we would like to hear from you.
