jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer — 1Secure Platform
jobs.description:
About Us

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.

Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.

Position Overview 

We are building a cutting-edge Platform that will transform the way our customers identify, protect and govern their data. This will revolutionize how customers secure their data by placing identity at the core — providing unparalleled visibility and control.

We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to design, build, and operate the services powering our enterprise SaaS security platform. You will work across a microservices architecture spanning ASP.NET Core APIs, Azure Functions, SQL Server, and Azure CosmosDB — shipping capabilities that serve Fortune 500 customers in hybrid cloud and on-prem environments at high scale.

This is a hands-on engineering role where strong technical execution, distributed-systems fluency, and a security-first mindset are essential. You will independently own features and services end-to-end, collaborating closely with product, architecture, and fellow engineers to deliver scalable, multi-tenant solutions that meet enterprise and regulatory standards.

This is a hybrid role with visits to our Kraków office.

Key Responsibilities 

Backend Service Development

Design and implement backend features end-to-end: from ASP.NET Core REST APIs and Azure Functions through to SQL Server and CosmosDB data layers.
Develop and extend .NET services within a microservices architecture composed of independently scalable, per-service function hosts.
Write and maintain Azure Functions for asynchronous processing workloads.
Build resilient, idempotent message-driven workflows using Azure Service Bus.

Data & Cloud Engineering

Work with SQL Server and Azure CosmosDB to implement performant, secure data access patterns at scale.
Own data access patterns that respect multi-tenant isolation boundaries and comply with security and privacy requirements, including RLS policy management.
Leverage Azure platform services including Service Bus, Blob Storage, Azure App Configuration, Application Insights, and Entra ID integration.

Quality & DevOps

Write comprehensive backend tests: xUnit, Moq, and FluentAssertions for unit and integration coverage.
Participate in CI/CD pipeline maintenance using GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps.
Contribute to infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and containerized local development (Docker Compose, Azurite).
Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, security vulnerabilities, and technical debt across services.

Collaboration & Growth

Independently break down and deliver complex backend work, owning full project lifecycles from design through production.
Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design decisions; enforce best practices across the codebase.
Partner with product managers and frontend/full-stack engineers to define clean, well-documented API contracts.
Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through pairing, code review, and knowledge sharing.
Champion the use of AI-driven approaches within the development process to enhance quality, speed, and innovation.

Qualifications  

6-8 years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong backend/distributed-systems focus.
Strong proficiency in **C# / .NET 8/10** (ASP.NET Core APIs, Azure Functions, isolated worker model).
Hands-on experience with **SQL Server** (T-SQL, Entity Framework Core, relational modelling, Row-Level Security) and at least one NoSQL database (CosmosDB preferred).
Experience building and operating **Azure-hosted** services (Functions, Service Bus, Blob Storage, App Configuration, Application Insights).
Solid understanding of **authentication and authorization** patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT, Auth0 or similar identity providers).
Experience with **multi-tenant SaaS** architectures and the data isolation patterns they require.
Comfortable designing and debugging **asynchronous, message-driven systems** (queues, event-driven processing, idempotency, retries).
Familiarity with **CI/CD pipelines** (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).
Familiarity with **Docker and Kubernetes**.
Strong testing discipline (unit, integration) using xUnit/Moq/FluentAssertions or equivalent.
Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team.

Preferred Qualifications 

Exposure to enterprise security domains (identity security, data security posture management, compliance).
Experience with **Azure CosmosDB** (SQL API and/or Gremlin graph API), including partitioning and throughput tuning.
Experience designing service boundaries in a **microservices architecture** with independent scaling and deployment.
Experience building compliance-ready products (e.g., SOC 2, FedRAMP, HIPAA, ISO 27001).

Our Values

At Netwrix, Our Values Guide Every Action

Next-Level Customer Focus -Customers first, always. We listen, protect, and go the extra mile— because their success is our mission.
Excellence - We set high standards and take pride in delivering exceptional results. We celebrate wins, seek constant improvement, and address shortcomings professionally.
Transparent Ownership - We celebrate our successes, own up to our mistakes, communicate openly, and face challenges head-on with a genuine commitment to doing the right thing.
Winning with Clear Thinking - We value clarity, find straightforward solutions to complex problems, and make swift, effective decisions.
Relentless Innovation - We continually seek better ways to serve our customers and stay ahead. We foster creative thinking, and we embrace new approaches.

jobs.description:
Who We Are 

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general.    

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.   

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

We are building and evolving Private Debt, a top-priority project for SimCorp right now and we are expanding the area to meet increasing client demand and deliver more outcomes. We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer with strong experience in test automation and a solid foundation in manual testing to ensure our product remains robust and reliable. You will also have the opportunity, and need, to learn APL, a functional programming language used in key parts of our stack. Prior experience with APL isn’t required, we provide comprehensive training and a supportive environment to help you succeed. Our company also partly owns Dyalog APL, ensuring the language remains actively maintained and relevant.

This is a great fit if you're a hands-on QA engineer who enjoys digging into code, designing automated tests, and wants to broaden your programming skills in new paradigms.

This role is pivotal in accelerating delivery cycles while maintaining high product quality. By automating critical test scenarios and integrating them into the CI/CD pipeline, you’ll help reduce manual testing effort, catch defects early, and ensure faster, more reliable releases-directly impacting customer satisfaction and business agility.

WHY PRIVATE DEBT, WHY NOW

Private Debt is growing rapidly in the market and we see increasing demand from existing and potential clients. That’s why SimCorp is investing in an efficient and attractive solution that supports Private Debt as a key part of illiquid investments, an area where our clients expect both innovation and robustness.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Design, build, and maintain test automation frameworks using APL, C# and related tools
Execute manual and exploratory testing to validate complex financial solutions and edge cases
Collaborate with developers, analysts, and product owners to define clear, testable requirements
Analyze and report bugs with clarity and precision
Help maintain product quality
Learn and apply APL to automate solutions built in this language (full training provided)
Contribute to continuous integration, quality gates, and deployment pipelines

What We Value

3+ years of experience in QA or software engineering with a focus on test automation
Proficiency in C# and .NET testing frameworks like SpecFlow/Reqnroll
Strong understanding of software QA methodologies, tools, and processes
Comfortable with manual testing in complex business domains (ideally finance or data-heavy systems)
Solid experience testing APIs, services, and data pipelines
A willingness and curiosity to learn APL, no prior experience required, but enthusiasm is essential
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Agile and BDD practices.

Additionaly We Value

Working with others to leverage the knowledge of everyone on the team
Taking responsibility for your work and striving to achieve tangible results
Trying new approaches to handle both new and existing challenges
Learning new skills and enhancing existing ones
Continually seeking ways to improve our processes and the way we work
Giving and receiving feedback in a way that promotes growth and understanding

Benefits 

Flexible working hours and hybrid model - 2 days in the office, 3 days remote
Modern office (next to Wilanowska metro station) with quiet zones and ergonomic workstations
Base salary with annual bonus structure 
Holiday allowance upon a 2-week vacation
Occasional remote work across Poland and international options available (up to 24 days domestic, 20 days international per year - subject to internal policy)
Employer-paid Medicover Platinum healthcare package (employee-paid family upgrade available)
MyBenefit Cafeteria with a monthly budget provided by SimCorp, which can be used to finance a Multisport card (with a 25% employee contribution) or choose other lifestyle options

Possibility to join Deutsche Börse Group Share Plan (eligible after 1 year)
Copyrights program for certain roles 
Possibility to develop your career in an international environment
Professional training and courses provided by SimCorp
Polish language classes for foreign employees; German and English classes based on business needs
Integration events, volunteering initiatives and employee-led clubs

Compensation ranges are being disclosed at the initial stage of candidate engagement.

NEXT STEPS

Please click below to apply to learn more about the vacancy and what SimCorp has to offer regarding salary, benefits, and perks. WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

Coro is Bain's persistent product development and engineering organization, building and operating the firm's proprietary digital solutions. Coro brings together technology, data, and services to create differentiated value for Bain's clients and case teams.
This role sits within Coro's DevOps and Assurance team, part of the Next Generation Software Solutions (NGSS) department. The team enables secure, efficient, and reliable delivery of technology across Bain's global ecosystem, focusing on both technical operations and platform assurance so that every deployment meets the firm's standards for quality, security, and compliance.
WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM 

The Staff Engineer owns the design, architecture, and long-term direction of cloud infrastructure and software delivery across Coro's DevOps and Assurance team. Working alongside architects and backend engineers, this engineer sets the technical standard for how the team provisions infrastructure, ships software, and secures its platforms, and ensures those platforms scale as the build plan expands.
This is a critical foundational role in the early stages of the platform build, requiring both strong technical fundamentals and the pragmatism to make infrastructure decisions that support a fast-moving product team.
WHAT YOU’LL DO 

Infrastructure Architecture & Automation – 30%

Own the design and evolution of cloud infrastructure built on Terraform and Terraform Cloud. Define the module structure, state strategy, and remote backend conventions the rest of the team builds against.
Architect Azure networking end to end: VNet/subnet topology, private endpoints, DNS resolution, NSG design, and Front Door Premium configuration across dev, demo, and production.
Set the standard for provisioning Azure platform services (App Services, Azure SQL, Azure OpenAI, Container Registry (e.g. Azure Container Registry, Cloudsmith), Key Vault, Entra ID, Storage Accounts / ADLS Gen2) and ensure environment parity by design.
Own the automation roadmap for the team: identify manual, repetitive operational work, own the backlog of it, and drive it toward self-service and infrastructure-as-code so operational load trends down over time.
Partner with Bain's central cloud and infrastructure teams to shape shared processes, tooling, and standards for operational work.

Cloud & Platform Management (Azure) – 20%

Own Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) architecture, including node pools, scaling strategy, spot instance usage, and workload connectivity to dependent services (databases, storage, AI services).
Define identity and access architecture: Entra ID app registrations, managed identities, RBAC model, and integration with external IdPs (Okta).
Set infrastructure standards for database platforms (Azure SQL Serverless, PostgreSQL Flexible Server, Cosmos DB), including connectivity, Entra auth, firewall rules, and private endpoints.
Ensure platform reliability and robust access controls across all environments, and act as the senior escalation point for platform-level issues.

CI/CD & Software Delivery – 15%

Define and own the CI/CD strategy using GitHub Actions for container builds, infrastructure deployments, and application releases, setting the patterns other engineers extend.
Establish the container image lifecycle standard: build, scan, push to a container registry (e.g. Azure Container Registry, Cloudsmith), and deploy to AKS or App Services.
Design environment promotion workflows with appropriate gating, secrets management (Key Vault), and rollback strategies.
Architect and operate GitHub-hosted private runners where required, including network integration with Azure VNets.

Monitoring, Security & Assurance – 15%

Own the observability strategy using the team's monitoring stack (e.g. Datadog, Azure Application Insights). Define what the team monitors, alerts on, and how it optimizes cost and reliability.
Lead the response to security findings: triage, containment, IAM scoping, container image CVE remediation, and endpoint hardening, and set the remediation standards others follow.
Lead L2/L3 incident escalations, including root-cause analysis, user journey tracing, and log analysis, and drive the improvements that prevent recurrence.
Define and enforce solution compliance across products: network isolation, least-privilege access, secrets hygiene, and deployment guardrails.
Own the developer experience: set the standard for local development environments and deployment documentation so engineers across the distributed team can onboard quickly and operate with minimal infrastructure friction.

Technical Leadership & Team Development – 20%

Lead and mentor DevOps engineers: set technical direction, review designs, grow the team's depth, and raise the bar on engineering practice.
Anticipate the needs of stakeholders across NGSS and the wider business, and shape the platform roadmap proactively rather than reactively.
Partner with architects, product engineers, and security teams to align on infrastructure standards and shape platform roadmaps across NGSS.
Drive DevOps culture and automation-first thinking across the engineering organization, and lead knowledge sharing.
Contribute to and often lead technical discovery, POCs, and innovation workstreams to validate new tools, technologies, and architectural patterns.

ABOUT YOU

Education & Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
7–9 years
of experience in DevOps, infrastructure engineering, or cloud platform engineering, with time spent at a senior or staff level.
Proven track record of architecting and operating cloud infrastructure in production at scale, owning technical decisions end to end.
Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring DevOps or platform engineers in fast-paced product organizations.

Professional Skills & Mindset

Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate complex technical topics for diverse stakeholders and to set direction others can follow.
Proactive, analytical, and systematic, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to trace issues across multiple layers (DNS, networking, identity, application).
Results-driven with a strong bias for automation and continuous improvement, and a track record of driving operational load down over time.
Comfortable owning ambiguity and working with limited direction: able to define standards and roadmaps where none exist yet, and to manage multiple stakeholders independently.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and a genuine commitment to team enablement and growth.

Technical Expertise

Deep hands-on expertise with Terraform 
and Terraform Cloud (or equivalent): module design, state strategy, and remote backends at scale.
Strong mastery of Azure services, including AKS, Networking (VNets, subnets, private endpoints, NSGs, DNS zones), App Services, Key Vault, Container Registry, and Storage Accounts
.
Deep experience with containerization technologies ( Docker, Kubernetes
) and container image lifecycle management.
Expertise in roles, permissions, and IAM,
particularly Microsoft Entra ID and Okta
.
Advanced CI/CD automation using GitHub Actions
, Azure DevOps, and related DevOps toolchains, with the ability to define patterns for a team.
Proficient in Linux administration and automation scripting ( Bash, PowerShell, Python
) for reusable workflows.
Strong command of monitoring and observability platforms (e.g. Datadog, Azure Application Insights
).
Deep familiarity with Azure private networking: private endpoints (blob, DFS, SQL, PostgreSQL), Private DNS Zones, and VNet integration for App Services and AKS
.
Command of database deployment and management from an infrastructure perspective, Azure SQL Serverless, PostgreSQL Flexible Server
, and Cosmos DB.
Strong foundation in security remediation
: container CVE patching, IAM scoping, NSG/firewall tightening, and WAF/Front Door rule management.

Preferred Qualifications

Professional certifications such as Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Azure Administrator, Terraform Associate, or CKA (or equivalent).
Experience owning multi-environment governance, cost optimization (FinOps), and compliance frameworks in cloud environments.
Familiarity with  Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Search, Databricks
, and the integration of AI services into enterprise platforms.
Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Airflow, or similar DAG/pipeline systems).
Snowflake
administration or connectivity from a DevOps lens.

Hos oss på Accigo får du vara med och stärka cloudaffären samtidigt som du utvecklar ditt självledarskap genom frihet under ansvar.

Vem är du?

Vi vill jobba med dig som vill vara med och bygga branschens starkaste affär och team inom Azure cloud consulting. Du drivs av teknisk utveckling samtidigt som du är en stjärna på att kommunicera på ett enkelt språk med kunder och kollegor. Du är lyhörd för kundens nuvarande behov och vågar samtidigt utmana befintliga arbetssätt och lösningar.

Vi söker dig som har

Flerårig erfarenhet av design och implementation av lösningar i Azure, inklusive god kännedom om Microsoft well architected framework & Cloud adoption framework.
Du har jobbat med on premises- eller hybrida system.
Du är bevandrad inom agilt arbetssätt och har stor kunskap av DevOps.
Kompetens inom Infrastructure as code (IaC) & PowerShell/CLI
Du har viss erfarenhet av att designa nätverk och tillhörande komponenter, i Azure och OnPrem.
Du har erfarenhet inom kravinsamling och presale-arbete
Mycket god kommunikationsförmåga och förmågan att leda ditt projekt och dig själv.
Gedigen erfarenhet som konsult där du jobbat med medelstora och stora bolag.

Ett plus om du har

Du har erfarenhet att vårda kundrelationer och driva säljprocesser
Erfarenhet av andra publika molntjänster
Microsoft Certifikat: AZ-104, AZ-305 och AZ-400
IT-Arkitektcertifiering från Dataföreningen eller liknade instans.
Erfarenhet av Cisco och Ubiquitinätverkstekniker

Detta kommer du att göra

Vi arbetar med att möjliggöra våra kunders digitalseringsresor genom att vara djupt tekniska specialister på kundens teknikplattformar, med utgångspunkt i Microsofts ekosystem. Du kommer jobba med kunder som behöver hjälp att flytta upp sina On Premis miljöer till Azure. Du kommer att designa lösningarna utifrån kundens krav och Microsoft well architected framework. Samt hjälpa till att implementera lösningarna.

Vi lägger stor vikt på gemensamma teamleveranser och vi samarbetar ofta med andra team på Accigo. Därför är det viktigt att du trivs med att jobba tillsammans med andra och samtidigt tar ansvar för din egen leverans.

I din roll som Cloud-arkitekt kommer du att agera lösningsarkitekt i våra kunduppdrag, hjälpa till med införsäljning, genomföra externa och interna kompetensutvecklingsinitiativ, design och uppsättning av Azurelösningar, samt hands-on och problemlösning. Du förväntas driva uppdrag och ta stort eget ansvar i dina projekt. Du kommer med din kompetens och branscherfarenhet vara en mycket viktig länk mellan affärsverksamhet och IT-infrastrukturen i Azure.

Vårt team

Vi är ett nyfiket och samarbetsvilligt team, med ett gemensamt brinnande intresse för teknik och digitalisering. Vi ser oss som Sveriges vassaste (och gladaste) team inom våra fokusområden, och har en långsiktig strategi att växa och bli fler. Vi arbetar dagligen med varandra, både i kundleveranser och med erbjudandeutveckling och att driva våra fokusområden.

Förutom att arbeta tillsammans bjuder vi även in till frukostar där vi delar med oss av pinsamheter och udda fakta, kompetensspridning, veckovisa team-träffar och spontana fikastunder. Vi strävar efter att skapa en vardag fylld med spännande projekt och möjligheter hos kund, samt glädje, energi och gemenskap i teamet där dina idéer får ta plats.

Kompensation och förmåner

Vår förmånspolicy är utvecklad för att möta både dina professionella och personliga behov. I vårt omfattande förmånspaket ingår friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension och frivillig sjukvårdsförsäkring. Vår ersättningsmodell består av en konkurrenskraftig fast del och en rörlig del som ger dig möjlighet att påverka din lön baserat på din prestation och ambition. Vi erbjuder både professionell och personlig utveckling.

Har du några frågor eller är du bara nyfiken? Vi berättar gärna mer om oss över en kaffe: tyra.drakenberg@accigo.se

Accigo är ett konsultbolag som hjälper företag och organisationer med digital affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling med tekniken som möjliggörare. För oss handlar digitalisering till 90% om människor och 10% om teknik. Det är när samspelet mellan människa och teknik fungerar som digitaliseringens fulla styrka visar sig.

För många handlar digitalisering mest om teknik. För oss är det så otroligt mycket större. Digitalisering kan få både människor och organisationer att våga sikta högre, följa sina drömmar och öppna dörrar som de inte ens visste fanns. Och när man ser igenom tekniken och börjar skönja vilka möjligheter som gömmer sig där bakom. Då ser man att framtiden kan vara en fantastisk plats – fylld av mänsklig energi och värme – och digitalisering är inget annat än vår superkraft för att komma dit.

Cognizant is one of the world's leading professional services companies, helping organizations modernize technology, reimagine processes, and transform experiences so they stay ahead in a fast-changing world. With over 300,000 associates globally, Cognizant combines a passion for client satisfaction, technology innovation, deep industry and business process expertise, and a global, collaborative workforce that embodies the future of work. Azure Agentic AI Architecture: Design and implement scalable, enterprise-grade Agentic AI solutions on Microsoft Azure, leveraging Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and Azure Machine Learning with well-defined data flows, component architecture, and resource optimization.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced software developer to help us develop desktop applications that enable our customers to evaluate and configure our products. This role is ideal for an individual who can communicate effectively with the team to identify solutions and then implement those solutions independently. The role includes everything from working with USB devices via an API or Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL), architecting and implementing business logic as well as implementing the UI using the Model View ViewModel (MVVM) paradigm.

Build new functionality that enables configuration of new hardware for customers and internal engineers

Identify problems with the team, design solutions, and implement them with quality and maintainability in mind
Work across architecture, business logic, and UI implementation to deliver reliable, polished user experiences

5+ years of professional experience developing products using C# (or equivalent object-oriented language with substantial C# proficiency)
Experience implementing MVVM using modern UI frameworks such as WPF, Avalonia, or MAUI (cross-platform experience is a bonus)
Strong knowledge of Git, including common merge strategies and practical debugging skills
Ability to communicate clearly, collaborate effectively, and deliver independently with a high level of ownership

ReactiveExtensions and/or ReactiveUI

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

We are building and evolving Private Debt, a top-priority project for SimCorp right now and we are expanding the area to meet increasing client demand and deliver more outcomes. We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer with expertise in C#, a deep understanding of its ecosystems and a strong background in object-oriented programming. The ideal candidate should be familiar with the .NET framework, skilled in designing and implementing architectural patterns. Additionally, proficiency in automated testing platforms, unit tests, and Git for code versioning, along with experience in Azure environments, is highly desirable. You will be part of an engineering team, contributing to everything from architecture and component design to performance and accessibility and responsible for delivering functionality that enables clients to make investment decisions with our back-office applications. The ideal candidate should have an eagerness to learn APL (A Programming Language). Prior experience with APL isn’t required, we provide comprehensive training and a supportive environment to help you succeed. Our company also partly owns Dyalog APL, ensuring the language remains actively maintained and relevant. For now, the most of our work is done in APL.

WHY PRIVATE DEBT, WHY NOW

Private Debt is growing rapidly in the market and we see increasing demand from existing and potential clients. Daarnaast maak je deel uit van het Architectuur Team, dat over de teams heen zorgt voor een consistente aanpak en waar de overkoepelende architectuur beslissingen worden genomen.

Technisch Leiderschap: Geef strategische richting voor het ontwerp, de ontwikkeling en implementatie van features, waarbij hoge beschikbaarheid, schaalbaarheid en beveiliging worden gegarandeerd.

Deployment Architecture: Ontwerp de applicatie-implementatie architectuur voor services, APIs en integraties, waardoor een modulaire en losgekoppelde architectuur wordt mogelijk gemaakt die hergebruik en snelle implementatie bevordert.
Security and Compliance: Implementeer beveiliging volgens de security by design-principes, waarbij wordt gegarandeerd dat het platform voldoet aan industriestandaarden zoals GDPR, SOC 2 en andere compliance vereisten.
Performance Optimization: Zorg ervoor dat de architectuur hoge beschikbaarheid, lage latentie en efficiënt gebruik van middelen ondersteunt, en streef naar continue verbetering.

Opleiding: Bachelor- of masterdiploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering of een gerelateerd vakgebied.
Minimaal 8 jaar ervaring in softwareontwikkeling, met ten minste 4 jaar in een software architect-rol gericht op SaaS-producten.
Bewezen ervaring in de architectuur van cloudgebaseerde oplossingen met platforms zoals GCP, AWS of Azure.
Sterk begrip van contract-first en event-driven architecturen, containerisatie (Docker, Kubernetes), micro-services en serverless technologieën.
Ervaring in de gezondheidszorg wordt als een pluspunt beschouwd.
Expertise in moderne programmeertalen zoals Java en idealiter Golang. Ervaring met Java en Spring Boot, en ervaring met Golang wordt als een groot pluspunt beschouwd.
Diepgaand begrip van databases (SQL/NoSQL), gedistribueerde systemen en event-driven architectuur.
Ervaring met CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps-praktijken en infrastructure as code (IaC).
Sterke kennis van security best practices en compliance-normen in SaaS-omgevingen.
Uitstekende probleemoplossende vaardigheden en het vermogen om in een samenwerkende omgeving te werken.
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden, met het vermogen om complexe technische concepten uit te leggen aan zowel technische als niet-technische belanghebbenden.
A can-do mentality: Je stelt oplossingen voor in plaats van problemen aan te kaarten en je kan actief mee in de code duiken
Je hebt ervaring binnen grotere omgevingen, waar er meerdere teams samen werken aan hetzelfde product.

Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About The Role

We are looking for a software engineer to build the cloud-native and full-stack systems that power customer-facing simulation at Skydio. In this role, you will design and implement the services, APIs, and interfaces that allow customers to configure, personalize, and interact with the Skydio Simulator at scale.

This is not a pure cloud role: you will work closely with the simulator itself, interfacing directly with C++ and Python systems that run real-time simulation and autonomy software. You’ll help bridge the gap between a complex robotics simulator and intuitive, flexible user experiences delivered through the cloud.

Areas Of Responsibility

Cloud-Backed Simulation Services: Build backend systems that orchestrate simulator execution, configuration, and lifecycle management in cloud environments.
Customer Personalization and Configuration: Enable customers to tailor simulation environments, scenarios, vehicles, and behaviors through robust APIs and services.
Simulator Integration: Design clean, reliable interfaces between cloud services and the core simulator runtime, including control, data exchange, and monitoring.
Full-Stack Experiences: Develop backend and frontend components that expose simulator capabilities through web interfaces and customer-facing tools.
Scalability and Reliability: Ensure simulation services are secure, observable, and scalable to support production customer workloads.

What You’ll Do

Design and build cloud-native services that orchestrate, configure, and interact with the Skydio Simulator at scale.
Develop robust backend systems that interface directly with the simulator runtime, enabling control, configuration, data exchange, and monitoring.
Build customer-facing workflows and APIs that allow users to personalize simulation environments, scenarios, vehicles, and behaviors.
Implement full-stack features, collaborating across backend services and frontend applications to deliver intuitive, reliable simulation experiences.
Partner closely with simulator, autonomy, and product teams to translate complex simulator capabilities into usable, production-ready customer features.
Architect systems with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, observability, and security, supporting multi-tenant, production workloads.
Contribute to technical direction and architectural decisions around how simulation is delivered as a cloud product.

Qualifications

Strong professional experience building backend and distributed systems in production environments.
Proficiency in Python and C++ (required), with the ability to integrate cloud services with performance-sensitive native systems.
Proficiency in modern frontend development using TypeScript and React.
Experience designing and consuming APIs, including GraphQL or similar API paradigms.
Experience with cloud and platform technologies such as AWS, Kubernetes, and PostgreSQL.
Comfort working across system boundaries — from cloud services and APIs down to simulator-facing interfaces.
Strong product sense and ability to design systems that are both technically sound and intuitive for customers.
Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across multiple teams and disciplines.

Bonus Experience

Experience with Go for backend or platform services.
Experience with Rust (strong plus), especially for systems, performance-sensitive, or infrastructure work.
Frontend experience with 3D or visualization technologies such as Three.js or WebGL.
Familiarity with workflow orchestration systems such as Temporal.
Experience productizing complex technical systems for external users.
Background or interest in simulation, robotics, or real-time systems.

We have created a multidisciplinary environment that embraces the power of diverse perspectives to create elegant solutions for complex problems. We are committed to growing our network of people, programs, and resources to nurture an inclusive culture.

Role Overview

Our client is a large, highly regulated organisation based in Abu Dhabi
seeking an experienced Infrastructure Architect to join its Cloud Platform team.

You will own the design, build and governance of the Azure foundations that delivery teams across the organisation build on, including subscriptions, networking, firewall and WAF, AKS, and the underlying logging and SIEM estate.

This is a hands-on
architecture role. You will produce high-level and low-level designs, deliver them as Infrastructure as Code alongside engineering teams, and ensure the platform operates reliably and securely in production.

The wider technology estate includes on-premises infrastructure, databases and middleware. Experience designing highly available and disaster-resilient architectures across complex hybrid environments, while providing technical leadership to engineering teams, will be highly valued.

Key Responsibilities

Azure Subscriptions & Governance
Manage Azure subscriptions, management groups and resource groups within an enterprise landing-zone model, enforcing naming, tagging, Azure Policy and RBAC standards.
Govern platform identity through Entra ID, including managed identities, service principals and PIM.
Monitor and optimise Azure cost, utilisation and capacity.

Networking, Firewall & WAF
Define VNets, subnets, IP address plans, peering and hub-and-spoke architectures.
Design hybrid connectivity using ExpressRoute/VPN, routing, DNS and Private Link.
Design, configure and operate Azure Firewall, including network/application rules, TLS inspection and IDPS.
Own WAF policies across Application Gateway and Front Door, including OWASP rule tuning.
Define network segmentation, DDoS protection, secure administrative access and firewall change-management processes.
Produce comprehensive HLDs, LLDs and SOPs.

Container Platform — AKS / Kubernetes
Define AKS reference architectures and hosting standards covering private clusters, node pools, networking, ingress, network policies and workload identity.
Harden AKS environments using image scanning, admission policies, Defender for Containers and Key Vault integration.

Als Senior Software Engineer geef je richting op technisch en architectuurniveau binnen complexe projecten. Je combineert hands-on development met het adviseren over technologiekeuzes, ontwikkelstrategieën, softwarearchitectuur en bewaakt de kwaliteit.

Zorg je dat best practices worden toegepast (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development);
Vertaal je business- en technische vraagstukken naar schaalbare oplossingen;
Stimuleer je moderne engineering practices en Developer Experience binnen de teams;
Ben je een inhoudelijke sparringpartner binnen het team, je helpt het technische niveau structureel te verhogen.

Softwareontwikkeling als teamsport

We hebben een passie voor softwareontwikkeling en zien het als een teamsport. Je werkt met gedreven, hoogopgeleide en betrokken software engineers in Navara teams samen.

Kennisdeling zit verweven in ons werk. Denk aan code reviews, pair programming, kennisfestival, LunchLabs en hackathons. Zo blijf je jezelf technisch ontwikkelen en leer je continu van andere engineers.

BerekenJeRecht
: met een team van 5 een applicatie bouwen die miljoenen mensen helpt inzicht te krijgen in hun rechten en financiële situatie (TypeScript, React frontend met Next.js , CI/CD met GitHub Actions, en IAC met Bicep);

Waarom werken bij Navara?

Bij Navara draait het om samen groeien en beter worden. Geen gebaande paden, maar echte uitdagingen in complexe omgevingen.

Een technische bachelor, master en/of PhD op zak;
Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring opgedaan;
Een onderzoekende houding waarbij je kritische vragen stelt en het leuk vindt om buiten de gebaande paden naar oplossingen te zoeken;
Een goede beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.

To keep up with the rapid market and business expansion and to support the company’s dynamic growth, we are looking for new ambitious colleagues.

GreenFlux is part of DKV Mobility Group, a major European Mobility company, and we play a leading role in the transition towards sustainable mobility for our ‘own’ customers and those of the Group.

To support our continued growth and the increasing maturity of our cloud platform, we are looking for a new ambitious colleague to strengthen our Infrastructure team.

The Job

We are looking for a Senior DevOps / Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to join our Development Department.

In this role, you will help us further standardize, automate and modernize our Azure DevOps and Azure infrastructure landscape, both from a technical and process point of view. You will work closely with Infrastructure, Development, Operations and Product teams to improve deployment processes, strengthen Infrastructure as Code practices, increase reusability, and support secure and scalable cloud platform operations.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role for someone who can not only maintain existing solutions, but also challenge current ways of working, propose improvements, and help drive technical standardization across teams. You can explain technical concepts clearly, document your work properly, and ask the right critical questions when needed.

You should be confident in taking ownership of technical topics, while also understanding the importance of alignment, reusability, security and maintainability.

Key Responsibilities

Support, maintain and improve our Azure DevOps environment, with a strong focus That ion automation, scalability, standardization and security.
Design, implement and maintain reusable CI/CD pipelines using YAML, ensuring consistency and efficiency across projects.
Improve pipeline consistency across projects, including multi-repository pipeline patterns and reusable pipeline components.
Apply Infrastructure as Code practices using Bicep, with a strong focus on module reusability, maintainability and standardization.
Contribute to the modernization of deployment processes across multiple products and teams.
Contribute to the adoption of Managed Identity across Azure resources and deployment workflows.
Work on Azure networking topics such as VNets, VPN Gateway, Private Link and Private DNS zones.

new_jobs.title: Azure Cloud Architect/Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is een toonaangevende wereldwijde speler op het gebied van IT-diensten, digitale oplossingen en bedrijfsstrategieën. We werken nauw samen met onze klanten om hun bedrijven te vereenvoudigen, te versterken en te transformeren, waarbij we streven naar de hoogste niveaus van zekerheid en tevredenheid. Onze kracht ligt in een diepgewortelde toewijding aan onze klanten, een uitgebreide branchekennis en een wereldwijd netwerk van innovatie- en leveringscentra.

Met meer dan 616.171 hooggekwalificeerde consultants, die 157 nationaliteiten vertegenwoordigen in 53 landen, heeft TCS een wereldwijde aanwezigheid. Sinds onze vestiging in Nederland in 1992, werken we samen met vooraanstaande Nederlandse bedrijven in uiteenlopende sectoren, waaronder meerdere NL20-bedrijven. TCS staat op de eerste plaats in klanttevredenheid onder IT-dienstverleners in Nederland volgens een enquête van Whitelane Research en is erkend als Top Employer in Nederland, Europa en wereldwijd door het Top Employers Institute.Voor meer informatie, bezoek www.tcs.com.

Over de functie

Wij zijn op zoek naar een ervaren Azure Cloud Architect met meer dan 12 jaar IT-ervaring om leiding te geven aan het ontwerp en de verdere ontwikkeling van enterprise-scale cloudarchitecturen binnen Microsoft Azure. De ideale kandidaat definieert de cloudstrategie, ontwerpt veilige en schaalbare oplossingen, begeleidt platform- en engineeringteams en fungeert als vertrouwde technisch adviseur voor zowel business als IT-management.
Verantwoordelijkheden
Definiëren en beheren van de algehele Azure cloudarchitectuurstrategie, roadmap en doelarchitectuur.
Ontwerpen van enterprise-scale, hoog beschikbare en veerkrachtige oplossingen op het gebied van compute, networking, storage en dataservices.
Leiden van het ontwerp van Azure Landing Zones, hub-spoke netwerkarchitecturen en multi-region/multi-subscription omgevingen.
Adviseren over applicatiemodernisering, containerisatie (AKS) en de adoptie van microservices.
Ontwerpen van cloud security architecturen in samenwerking met securityteams, inclusief identity management, netwerksegmentatie, encryptie en Zero Trust-principes.
Opzetten en bewaken van architectuurgovernance, waaronder ontwerpstandaarden, referentiearchitecturen en herbruikbare patronen.
Definiëren van cloudmigratiestrategieën en roadmaps (lift-and-shift, replatform, refactor) vanuit on-premises of andere cloudplatformen naar Azure.
Evalueren en adviseren over Azure-services, derdenoplossingen en nieuwe technologieën die aansluiten bij bedrijfsdoelstellingen.
Verantwoordelijk voor disaster recovery-, business continuity- en high-availability architecturen.
Samenwerken met FinOps- en finance-teams om kostenefficiënte cloudoplossingen te ontwerpen.
Optreden als technisch adviseur voor senior management en bedrijfsvereisten vertalen naar cloudarchitectuurkeuzes.
Begeleiden en coachen van DevOps-, platform- en securityteams op architectuurniveau.
Uitvoeren van architectuurreviews en waarborgen van alignment met het Microsoft Well-Architected Framework.
Opstellen en onderhouden van architectuurdocumentatie, diagrammen en Architecture Decision Records (ADR's).
Op de hoogte blijven van de Azure roadmap en cloud-native innovaties om de cloudstrategie verder te ontwikkelen.

Must-have

Minimaal 12 jaar ervaring in IT, waarvan minimaal 7 jaar als Cloud Architect of Solution Architect binnen Azure.
Diepgaande expertise in Azure-services zoals Compute, Networking, Storage, Identity, Databases en Integration Services.
Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwerpen van Azure Landing Zones en enterprise-scale cloudarchitecturen.
Sterke ervaring met Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep en ARM Templates) op architectuur- en governance-niveau.
Uitgebreide kennis van Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), microservices en containergebaseerde architecturen.

Ervaring met hybride en multi-cloud architecturen, waaronder Azure Arc, ExpressRoute en VPN-oplossingen.
Grondige kennis van het Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Framework en de vijf pijlers daarvan.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer L1
new_jobs.description:
We are hiring an early-career Software Engineer for the Connectivity team in our Amsterdam hub.

Full-time · Hybrid · Amsterdam · €45,000-€60,000 per year + Stock Options

About Katanox

Katanox is building the infrastructure layer for hospitality: software that connects hotels and travel buyers and moves money between them. Our platform brings distribution and payments into one workflow (contracting, connectivity, reconciliation, and settlement), so partners can operate with less fragmentation and fewer manual handoffs.

For engineers, this means building reliable systems that handle complex B2B workflows and real financial constraints, with a focus on data integrity, auditability, security, and operational excellence. We're headquartered in Amsterdam with hubs in London and New York.
About the role
You'll join the Connectivity team, which owns the Katanox marketplace end-to-end. On the supply side, hotels connect through their property management systems and channel managers. On the demand side, travel buyers integrate through our public API. In between sits the contracting flow, which decides which buyer can sell which hotel on which terms. 

Availability, rates, and inventory enter the platform on one side, reservations leave on the other, and contracts in the middle decide what each buyer sees. If a rate update from a hotel is dropped, a buyer sells the wrong price. If a reservation is not delivered, a guest arrives to no room.
This is an L1 role. We expect you to arrive with solid fundamentals and real curiosity, not years of production experience. You will pair with senior engineers, own small pieces end-to-end from your first weeks, and grow into owning an integration yourself.

What you will work on
Build and extend integrations with hotel systems: map a partner's availability, rates, and reservation models onto ours, in Kotlin, with tests and code review.
Ship changes to the public API that travel buyers use to search and book.
Work with real third-party APIs, with their retries, rate limits, and odd edge cases, and keep that mess out of the rest of the platform.
Own your services in production: when a rate update or a booking fails somewhere between a hotel and a buyer, you find out why, fix it at the source, and add the monitoring that catches it next time.

What you will grow into
Owning a whole integration or API area end to end, from design to rollout.
The contracting flow: the rules that decide which buyer can sell which hotel on which terms.
Keeping availability and pricing correct at scale. Millions of searches a day depend on the data your services ingest.
Weighing in on architecture decisions with the senior engineers you pair with.

What we are looking for
Around zero to two years of professional experience, or a strong internship and side-project record. A degree is welcome but not required.
Solid fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, testing, and enough system design to reason about a service boundary.
Working knowledge of Kotlin or Java, or another typed language and a clear interest in Kotlin.
Comfort reading other people's API documentation and code, and patience for edge cases. Connectivity is a domain of exceptions.
Curiosity about how travel distribution and payments work, and the ownership to pick up a problem rather than wait for someone else.
Fluent in English, and based in or around Amsterdam.

How we work

A cornerstone of our culture is in-person collaboration. We follow a "hub" model with unique hubs in Amsterdam, London, and New York, where we regularly collaborate face-to-face, onboard customers and colleagues, hold design sessions, and host events.

We do not hire for strictly remote roles. We expect people to spend meaningful time in our hubs because this is how we maintain our culture, build trust, and move quickly together.

We're also a financially regulated
company. That means high standards for security, auditability, and decision-making. This means your work ships with the rigor and reliability you'd expect from systems that move real money.

Our values
At Katanox, our values are the blueprint for how we work together and build our product.
Team over the individual, no ego
: We prioritize the success of the whole team over individual agendas. We win together, share credit, and leave egos at the door.
Data beats excitement
: We welcome bold ideas, but we commit based on evidence. We use data, experimentation, and clear hypotheses to decide what to build.
Dare to do
: We are proactive, take smart risks, and move from talking to doing. We learn by shipping and improve through iteration.
See it, own it, and close it
: When we spot a problem or opportunity, we take responsibility to drive it to completion instead of assuming someone else will.
We apply radical candor
: We care personally and challenge directly. We give and receive honest feedback so we can grow faster as individuals and as a team.
In person first, call second
: We prioritize in-person collaboration in our hubs to build trust, move quickly, and solve hard problems together.
Build collaboratively
: We actively involve the right people, share context early, and co-create solutions across teams and disciplines.
Iterate fast and pragmatically
: We ship small, learn quickly, and avoid over-engineering. We focus on solutions that work in reality, not just in theory.

Live Technical Assessment
System Design
Meeting with the CEO
Offer

Sterke technische kennis van het Microsoft Dynamics CRM platform
Je bent technisch zeer goed onderlegd, heb ervaring met coderen en bent in staat op configuratie niveau maatwerk in de applicatie door te zetten.

13e maand

new_jobs.title: Software-ingenieur
new_jobs.description:
Bij Navara bouwen we software die werkt: oplossingen die live gaan en aantoonbare impact maken. Van digitale producten die miljoenen mensen gebruiken tot complexe systemen in het hart van organisaties. Je werkt in Navara teams waarin je veel invloed hebt op technische keuzes. Met moderne technologie, bewezen engineering practices en veel aandacht voor developer experience helpen we organisaties echte techbedrijven te worden.

Wat ga je doen?

Je denkt mee over technische keuzes, vertaalt user stories naar robuuste implementaties en optimaliseert deze continu. Je krijgt veel eigenaarschap binnen kleine, hoogwaardige teams.

Verder:
Zorg je dat best practices worden toegepast (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development);
Vertaal je business- en technische vraagstukken naar schaalbare oplossingen;
Werk je in nauwe samenwerking met je team, waarin code reviews en inhoudelijke afstemming centraal staan.

We zien ons werk als teamsport

Je werkt binnen een sterke engineering cultuur met focus op Developer Experience. We zien softwareontwikkeling als een teamsport. Je werkt samen met gedreven engineers aan hoogwaardige oplossingen, met moderne technologie en bewezen best practices als basis.

Kennisdeling zit verweven in ons werk. Denk aan code reviews, pair programming, kennisfestival, LunchLabs en hackathons. Zo blijf je jezelf technisch ontwikkelen en leer je continu van andere engineers.

Onze impact

Je werkt aan software die dagelijks door grote groepen mensen wordt gebruikt. Een aantal voorbeeld projecten waar we nu aan werken zijn:

BerekenJeRecht
: met een team van 5 een applicatie bouwen die miljoenen mensen helpt inzicht te krijgen in hun rechten en financiële situatie (TypeScript, React frontend met Next.js , CI/CD met GitHub Actions, en IAC met Bicep);
Integratie van het nieuwe pensioenstelsel (Wtp)
: alles wat deelnemers en werkgevers zien, loopt via systemen waar jij aan bouwt. Dit doe je samen met een team van 8 collega’s (Python, Docker, AWS, Azure);
Slim laden van elektrische auto’s
: software bouwen in een team van 8 die ervoor zorgt dat auto’s op duurzame en efficiënte momenten worden opgeladen (AWS en TypeScript, Kafka).

Je bouwt dus niet alleen systemen, maar oplossingen die zichtbaar impact maken in de maatschappij.

We werken ook met andere technologieën zoals C#, Java, Python, TypeScript en frameworks als Angular en React. Qua cloudtechnologie werken we met Azure en AWS.

Waarom werken bij Navara?

Bij Navara draait het om samen groeien en beter worden. Geen gebaande paden, maar echte uitdagingen in complexe omgevingen.

Verder kan je nog denken aan:
Er is veel aandacht en ruimte voor ontwikkeling, zo heb je sessies met je Technology Officer en mentor om je ontwikkeling gericht te sturen;
Een helder groeipad, richting technische diepgang of juist leiderschap;
Flexibel werken (hybride);
Regelmatige kennissessies, meetups, hackathons en andere bedrijfsactiviteiten;
Een salaris tussen de € 3.500,- en €5.000,- euro per maand én maandelijkse bonus;
Een vast contract, leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding, netto telefoon- en onkostenvergoeding en een premievrij pensioen.

Wat verwachten we van jou?

Je ziet kansen voor verbetering en neemt het initiatief om samen met je team nieuwe technieken of methodieken uit te proberen. Verder heb jij:
Een technische bachelor, master en/of PhD op zak;
Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring opgedaan;
Nieuwsgierigheid en de drive om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen;
Een goede beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.

Over onze Business Unit Utrecht

We vinden teambuilding en een goede, informele werksfeer erg belangrijk. Onze Business Unit telt zo’n 50 collega’s en we werken vanuit een prachtig kantoor in Driebergen-Rijsenburg. Zo heb je regelmatig check-ins met iemand van het MT (Ron, Geert Jan of Christine) wandelend door de bossen. We organiseren activiteiten zoals onze wekelijkse crossfit, boekenclub, padel, boulderen, BBQs, en het jaarlijkse kerstfeest en wintersport.

Ben je benieuwd naar meer informatie of wil je eerst even vrijblijvend sparren? Dan is dit natuurlijk mogelijk, we vertellen je graag meer! Solliciteer via LinkedIn of mail naar recruiters@navara.nl.

About the Company

At IMSERV, we're proud to be one of the UK's leading energy data and metering specialists. We deliver award-winning services to customers across the country, providing specialist metering technology for electricity, gas and water, alongside highly accurate energy data collection services.

About the Role

The role will own the architecture of the Astral platform, including the governed data foundation, orchestration, rules and entitlement engine, integration layer, API tier, portal and partner front ends, and the AI layer. The role will also act as the design authority for all significant technical decisions across the product squads and own the technical roadmap from the current estate to the target state, working closely with the Head of Development. A key focus of this roadmap will be the transition from a single-tenant to a multi-tenant architecture.

Responsibilities

Keep the current and target architecture documented, validated and understood across the department.
Review and approve significant technical decisions: patterns, technology choices, integration approaches and third-party services.
Define the API strategy: portal, analytics and data-feed APIs treated as products, with entitlement (who sees what, down to meter point, site and channel) enforced once at the tier.
Design the multi-utility data architecture: how metering, consumption, carbon, asset and CRM data flows from replaceable source systems through the integration layer (Microsoft Fabric and middleware) and is productised for operational and commercial use.
Design the rules and orchestration layer: an event backbone, an orchestration engine for job lifecycles, a decision engine driven by business-editable decision tables, and read models served through the APIs. Adopt proven engines rather than building bespoke ones and run advisory-only before automating actions.
Design the AI layer: retrieval over the data foundation, guardrails, and model and service selection, respecting entitlement throughout.
Lead build-versus-buy evaluations on total cost, time to value and lock-in risk.

What you'll need

Knowledge & Qualifications
Significant experience as a technical or solutions architect on customer-facing SaaS platforms, spanning web applications, API tiers and data platforms.
Direct experience of multi-tenant SaaS architecture, ideally including a single-tenant to multi-tenant migration.
An engineering background on or near our stack: C#/.NET, Angular and Azure.
Experience of event-driven architecture and workflow or rules tooling: orchestration engines (Azure Durable Functions, Temporal, Camunda or similar), decision tables (DMN), message backbones and CQRS-style read models.
Practical, current knowledge of AI: LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, agent patterns, and what it takes to run them safely over commercial customer data.
Knowledge of the wider Microsoft estate, ideally including Microsoft Fabric; hands-on Azure AI services desirable.
Energy or utilities domain knowledge desirable: metering, half-hourly settlement, MHHS, carbon reporting.

Skills
Data architecture depth for high-volume time-series and reference data.
Able to work pragmatically in a smaller or scaling organisation, where sequencing matters more than frameworks.
Able to explain a trade-off to a non-technical executive as clearly as to an engineering team.
Sound commercial judgement on build-versus-buy and technology selection.

new_jobs.title: Head of Engineering
new_jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Atrom Mindcare is building the next generation of mental healthcare delivery. We're a UK based Mental Healthcare provider operating at the intersection of NHS, insurance, and private care, with a clear thesis: that mental healthcare can be delivered more thoughtfully, more efficiently, and at a higher quality than the legacy systems most of the sector still relies on.
We're now looking for a Senior Engineering Lead to help us build the platform that makes this possible.

What we are building

We're on a mission to make the patient journey smoother and swifter while also enabling the clinicians to be able to make full use of technology to deliver high standards of care - a unified seamless platform that:
•       Handles the full referral lifecycle from intake to clinical decision
•       Uses AI thoughtfully — to augment clinical and administrative judgement, not replace it
•       Maintains rigorous audit trails and meets the highest standards of healthcare data protection
•       Integrates with existing (internal and external) clinical systems rather than replacing them
•       Scales as we grow without losing the careful clinical attention that defines good mental healthcare

Some foundational work is already in place. The next phase needs someone who can take this from "good start" to "real platform."

The Role

You'll be the Business and technical voice at Atrom — owning the architecture, leading the build, and shaping where the platform goes next. This isn't a job where someone hands you a detailed spec. It's a role where you help define what we're building, then make it real.

Your work will include:
•       Architecture and direction — making the strategic technical decisions that determine what's possible
•       Hands-on delivery — you'll build significant components yourself, not just direct others
•       Quality and standards — establishing how we build, test, secure, and ship
•       Healthcare context — understanding what makes clinical software different from generic SaaS
•       Working with founders — directly with the CEO (operational strategy) and Clinical Director (medical reality)

You'll inherit some good foundations: existing infrastructure, a working prototype, clear strategic direction. What you bring is the experience to make this into a platform that genuinely changes how mental healthcare is delivered.

What we are looking for

You're probably right for this if:
•       You've delivered platform-scale software before (not just features within someone else's platform)
•       You're comfortable with Microsoft Power Platform, Azure services, and modern integration architectures — or you've built equivalent capability on adjacent stacks and are happy moving into ours
•       You understand AI as a tool you've actually deployed in production, not a buzzword
•       You have an instinct for security, privacy, and audit — particularly in regulated contexts
•       You write code well and lead other engineers well
•       You communicate clearly in writing (we're remote-async-first)
•       You're drawn to mission-driven work — mental healthcare isn't an industry you stumble into

You're probably not right for this if:
•       You're looking for a defined task list and step-by-step directions
•       You want to be insulated from the business or clinical context
•       Healthcare regulation feels like a hassle rather than something to engineer around respectfully
•       You'd rather work on consumer apps or enterprise SaaS where the stakes are lower

What we offer

•       Competitive salary — we'll match the market for the right person at this level
•       Real ownership — of the technical direction, not just the codebase
•       Direct work with the founders — no layers, no committees
•       Genuine impact — what you build affects real patients and clinicians
•       Remote-first flexibility — work when and where you work best
•       Modern stack — Azure, Power Platform, OpenAI, current tooling
•       Growth opportunity — as Atrom grows, this role grows with it

About Atrom Mindcare

We were founded in 2023 by Amrish Gupta (CEO) and Dr Aarohee Desai-Gupta (Clinical Director, Consultant Psychiatrist). We specialise in outpatient mental health, including ADHD and ASD assessment and treatment, delivered through both NHS Right to Choose and private channels. We're growing rapidly, operating in a market where demand vastly outstrips quality supply, and we're investing in our platform because we believe technology done right is how mental healthcare moves forward.
We're small enough that you'll see your work matter, structured enough that you'll have what you need to do your best work, and ambitious enough that this is a meaningful career move for the right person.

How to apply

If this resonates, we'd love to hear from you. Send us:
•       A brief note about why this opportunity interests you
•       Your background — link to LinkedIn, GitHub, portfolio, or a CV
•       Examples of platform-scale work you've led
•       A few questions you'd ask us (this tells us more than most CVs do)

Apply via

•       Email: recruitment@atrommindcare.com

Strong fits will be invited to a conversation rather than a structured interview — we want to understand each other before deciding.

Atrom Mindcare Limited is an equal opportunities organisation. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and particularly encourage those underrepresented in healthcare technology to apply.

Project Description:

You will join a long-term, enterprise-scale project for a global client in the investment banking domain. The project focuses on building and evolving a set of mission-critical backend services that support complex business workflows, regulatory processes, and system integrations across the bank’s ecosystem.

new_jobs.title: .NET utvecklare
new_jobs.description:
Vill du kombinera modern .NET-utveckling med automation, integrationer och DevSecOps?

Vi söker nu en .NET-utvecklare till Skandias DevSecOps-team som utvecklar interna plattformar, verktyg och integrationer som används av utvecklingsteam i hela Skandia.

Att jobba som .NET-utvecklare

Som .NET-utvecklare blir du en del av ett tvärfunktionellt DevSecOps-team med ansvar för interna plattformar och verktyg. Tillsammans utvecklar och förvaltar ni lösningar som används av utvecklare i hela Skandia. Genom ett nära samarbete med andra team bidrar ni till effektiva, säkra och moderna utvecklingsflöden.

I Rollen Kommer Du Bland Annat Att

utveckla och vidareutveckla interna portaler och egenutvecklade lösningar
bygga integrationer mellan olika system, exempelvis Azure DevOps och ServiceNow
automatisera processer och arbetsflöden enligt principen Everything as Code
vidareutveckla och förbättra bygg-, test- och deployprocesser i Azure DevOps och Octopus Deploy
bidra till säkra och effektiva utvecklingsprocesser med fokus på kodkvalitet, säkerhet och automation

Vi arbetar agilt enligt SAFe och i nära samarbete med andra utvecklingsteam, där du bidrar till den fortsatta utvecklingen och förvaltningen av plattformen.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

flera års erfarenhet av utveckling i C# och .NET
erfarenhet av backendutveckling och systemintegrationer
goda kunskaper i Git, YAML och PowerShell
erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt, exempelvis SAFe
goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy, CI/CD eller testautomation.

Vem är du?

Vi tror att du är en nyfiken och lösningsorienterad person som trivs med att ta dig an tekniska utmaningar och hitta smarta lösningar. Du trivs med att samarbeta med andra, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och bidrar till ett öppet och hjälpsamt teamklimat.

Du är nyfiken på ny teknik och har en vilja att kontinuerligt utveckla både dig själv och de lösningar du arbetar med.

Vad händer nu? 

I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.

Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.

Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Izabella Rolnik på izabella.rolnik@skandia.se.

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med Nina Fazeli på nina.fazeli@skandia.se.

Vi kommer att ta ett sommaruppehåll i rekryteringsprocessen och återupptar intervjuerna i augusti.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan, och trevlig sommar!

Mer om IT

Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto! 

Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv. 

Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

.NET System Integration Specialist - Telecom - Gothenburg (Hybrid)

I am hiring for a Senior Integration Specialist / Backend Developer to join a growing technology team in the telecoms sector, based in Gothenburg.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced backend developer who enjoys solving complex integration challenges and wants to work on technically interesting projects where security, reliability, and problem-solving are key.

You’ll be working on an integration platform connecting external software with highly secure enterprise environments, using APIs, middleware, authentication, and secure data transfer.

Responsibilities:

Build and maintain integration platforms and backend services.
Develop and integrate APIs across multiple systems.
Design secure and reliable data transfer between different environments.
Integrate third-party software with enterprise systems.
Contribute to technical architecture and integration design.
Work with authentication, security, and enterprise integration patterns.
Contribute to DevOps, deployment, and ongoing technical improvements.

Requirements:

Strong commercial experience as a Backend Developer, Integration Specialist, or similar.
Strong experience with system integration and API development.
Experience with .NET. Other languages will also be considered with strong integration experience.
Good understanding of APIs, middleware, authentication, and secure data transfer.
Some experience with DevOps and deployment processes.
Strong communication skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
Experience working in highly secure or security-cleared environments would be advantageous.

As the initial project is within the national security space, candidates must be Swedish citizens and able to successfully obtain security clearance.

Why join?

Work on technically challenging projects within telecoms and national security.
Join a small, ambitious, and highly collaborative technology team.
Have direct access to senior leadership and opportunities to influence the direction of the business.
Strong focus on learning, knowledge sharing, and career development.
Excellent company culture, including international team events and conferences.
A flexible remuneration package allowing you to structure your compensation across salary, pension, and other benefits.
Location: Gothenburg – hybrid, approximately 3 days per week in the central Gothenburg office.

Please apply via the Easy Apply function.

For more information, please email l.letchford@tenthrevolution.com.

The application deadline is the 9th of October. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so early applications are encouraged.

Job Description

Req ID: FEQ327R409

The team

The Fungible team is the “rapid-response squad” within the Field Engineering organisation that engages with customers on the most strategic, highest-potential opportunities across Benelux and the Nordics to accelerate critical use cases, land technical wins, and drive successful Databricks adoption. If you enjoy working on novel use cases across a variety of industries on highly visible engagements, this is the right home for you!

The role

As a Fungible Solutions Architect, you lead the technical strategy on time-boxed, targeted engagements
- typically one to five months - aimed at accelerating a specific set of critical customer workloads from evaluation to a production-grade technical win. You own the architecture conversation, drive platform adoption, and act as a trusted advisor to customer architects and engineering leaders, then transition the momentum you've built to the core account team.

You bring technical depth and the judgment to apply it fast, in situations that require strong ownership
and are highly visible
. Where a specialisation helps you contribute quickly, great — but on this team, breadth, adaptability, and a bias for impact matter just as much as your area of depth.

The impact you will have

Accelerate what matters most: parachute into strategic, high-profile opportunities and own a clearly defined technical area, moving critical workloads and use cases from evaluation toward production and consumption.
Lead the architecture: design scalable, production-grade solutions across data engineering, ML/AI, and real-time analytics, and lead the whiteboarding, design reviews, and trade-off decisions with senior customer stakeholders.
Win the technical decision: demonstrate Databricks' differentiation through custom-built solutions in competitive, must-win scenarios.
Move fast while maintaining the bar: establish momentum quickly in ambiguous situations and compress timelines without cutting corners.
Hand off, don't hold on: package your progress into a clean transition to core SAs, DSAs, specialists, or partners so wins are sustained and expanded after you move to the next engagement.
Scale: bring back patterns, plays, and product feedback that make every engagement after yours faster.

What We Look For

We care more about how you think and the impact you've had than about a specific checklist. You'll likely bring most of the following, and if you're missing one or two but bring something we haven't thought of, we still want to hear from you!

Several years of experience (typically ~6+) in solutions architecture, data engineering, technical pre-sales, or a senior hands-on technical role, or a track record that demonstrates equivalent depth.
Hands-on coding ability in Python and SQL, with the ability to build, debug, and demonstrate working solutions live.
Depth in distributed data systems and production cloud deployments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), scalable pipelines, streaming, and lakehouse patterns, plus the infrastructure, security, and governance to run them.
Proficiency on the Databricks Platform, or a demonstrated ability to ramp on new technology quickly. A strong "spike" in an area such as real-time/streaming, ML/AI, data governance, or migrations helps you add value fast.
Experience leading architecture discussions with senior technical stakeholders, design reviews, trade-off analysis, clear recommendations, and translating complex architecture into business value for both engineers and executives.
The temperament this team runs on: comfort with ambiguity and time-boxed engagements, strong prioritisation, and a genuine preference for variety and high-impact work.

Nice to haves

Given our role in the Field Engineering organisation, we are always looking to expand the depth our team can offer with your areas of specialisation. Any of the following would be a valuable addition to the team!

Databricks certifications (Data Engineer, ML, or Platform).
Familiarity with competitive platforms (Snowflake, AWS native services, Azure Synapse) and how to position against them.
Background in a data/AI company or cloud provider.
Depth in an industry vertical (Financial Services, Healthcare, Retail, Media, and others).

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

Benefits

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

Compliance
